title: Assistant Professor Position in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering
description:
SDU Mechanical Engineering (SDU ME) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering. SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The position is available from January 1, 2027, with the specific start date to be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

 

The position and research environment 

You will join the maritime group at Mechanical Engineering, where the main research topics are seakeeping, data-driven maintenance, and energy systems and efficiency. The group works within applied research, carried out in close collaboration with industry and other research groups. The group is part of the larger Maritime Center at SDU, offering strong opportunities for transdisciplinary and cross-faculty collaboration. In addition, the center is actively developing strong relationships with external partners. The candidate is expected to play an active role in this community, contributing both to research and administrative activities within the center. This includes outreach to other universities, industry, maritime educational institutes, authorities, and professional organizations to establish and strengthen collaborative relationships.

Furthermore, SDU conducts defense-related research. The successful candidate is therefore expected to have an interest in dual-use research within the relevant research fields, and to actively engage in outreach to other universities as well as the Danish Defence.

To complement our team, we are looking for candidates within naval architecture and marine engineering / mechanical engineering, with documented research experience in one of the following fields:

  • Data-driven operation of ships – Energy efficiency and predictive maintenance, digital twins, and the use of machine learning and sensor data to optimize vessel operation and efficiency.

  • Seakeeping and comfort onboard vessels - ship motion analysis, ship stability, vibration and noise reduction, or human comfort and habitability at sea.

You will bring competence and dedication to teaching and student supervision in mechanical engineering at SDU ME, actively contributing to our two educational programs: Bachelor of Engineering (diplomingeniør) and Bachelor's and Master of Science (civilingeniør). Our engineering programs combine theory courses with project work, and you will be involved in both. 

 

Workplace

SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The research activities at SDU ME span widely from fluid mechanics, multi-physics simulation and optimization to condition monitoring and structural dynamics, composite materials, mechanical design, and naval architecture and marine engineering. IME is a multidisciplinary department covering also high-frequency electronics, microelectronics, batteries and super-capacitors, additive manufacturing, smart structures and energy technologies. The department is an exciting environment, where you will be exposed to many different fields and have your general academic curiosity stimulated.

The position is full-time and located at the SDU main campus in Odense. Given the research, teaching, and collaborative nature of the position, you are expected to be present on campus on a regular basis and to relocate to Denmark, if currently residing abroad.

SDU Odense is the university’s largest campus and provides a strong framework for interdisciplinary research, teaching, and innovation. You will be part of a modern workplace with high professionalism, strong academic communities, and a commitment to diversity and equal opportunities. SDU also offers dedicated support for International Staff. Learn more about careers and work life at SDU here: Careers at SDU.

 

What we expect 

You must have:

  • Completed a PhD degree in a relevant discipline

  • The ability to teach basic mechanical engineering curricula

  • Communication skills in English at an adequate level for research communication and teaching

It is preferred that you also have experience from/with:

  • Postdoctoral research positions

  • Co-supervision of PhD students

  • Teaching and course development

  • Funding applications

  • Collaboration with industrial partners

You are expected to apply for own grants and to contribute to joint applications with the group and its collaborators. Strong potential to compete for national and international research funding is essential.

During the period of employment as Assistant Professor, you are expected to develop an independent research profile; publish high-quality research outputs; contribute to attracting external research funding; develop documented teaching and supervision competences, including completion of the Lecturer Training Programme; and contribute actively to collaboration, knowledge exchange, and the academic environment at SDU Mechanical Engineering.

 

Further information 

For more information about the position, contact Head of Section Associate Professor Dorte Smedegaard Schmidt (phone +45 65507432, e-mail dss@sdu.dk) or Professor Marie Lützen (phone +45 65509625, e-mail mlut@sdu.dk).

For more information about SDU ME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/da/mechanical.

For more information about IME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime. 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application (up to 2 pages). 

  • Complete Curriculum Vitae (up to 4 pages).

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications. 

  • Up to 10 publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • A proposed research plan (up to 4 pages).

  • References/reference letters may be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420 
We are excited to hear from you and potentially welcome you to our team!

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us.

title: Electrical Engineer - High Voltage; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
description:
Are you searching for a place to work where you can truly make a difference and have a leading role in our continued expansion? A role where you will have the trust as well as the responsibilities to play a key role in shaping the way we work? Then this is your chance to not just show what you’re made of, but also to join a world leader within renewables energy that have no intention to slow down the green energy transition.

Your position
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and creative solutions. You will get the unique opportunity to work in an environment characterized by dedication, passion, and ambition.

At Semco Maritime you will be joining our dedicated Product Line Team in our Renewables Division whose mission is to develop solutions for Offshore Substations engineered and constructed together with our close partners. Our goal is to standardize solutions while maintaining flexibility to align client needs with supplier capabilities. Offshore substation industrialisation is the key enabler for the green transition worldwide, and as such, your product solutions will need to reflect that. We have the largest project portfolio within offshore substations worldwide, so you will join a well-established company in growth and work with a team of changers.

“We are world-leading within offshore substations, and we have a strong focus on both AC and DC connections, as well as advanced floating technologies. Our Offshore Wind markets include Europe, Asia, and the USA, which means that you can expect to be involved in projects worldwide!” - Director, Product Line Management, Jannick Elmbæk Olsen.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Electrical Engineer for High Voltage, you will be responsible for development, implementation, and maintenance of the products and solutions offerings for our offshore substation product line.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • HV/MV product and solutions development and maintenance in line with future market requirements
  • Proposal development based on the architecture framework and the client’s requirements
  • Working closely with our Tender team focusing on our customers Employer Requirements and Semco Maritimes own modular architecture
  • Maintain knowledge on market demand and implement product improvements and requirements for product line to fit future projects
  • Coordinate and secure strategic supply chain together with Procurement, including cost-out activities
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap with input on new technologies from the supply chain, organization, and the market
  • Provide supervision and guidance to the development and execution teams

The successful candidate will be expected to form strong working relationships with the other existing teams e.g., in sales, tender, project management, construction, and most importantly, our in-house engineering organisation.

Your profile & qualifications
You are an experienced HV professional with a product development mindset, preferably coming from either an OEM or from an engineering organisation. Your collaborative spirit and commercial acumen will thrive in our international setting. In addition, you are a proactive team player with a continuous improvement mindset, analytical prowess, and a solution-oriented approach.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Have experience with design, procurement and construction of the high voltage and medium voltage systems, such as electrical distribution, power transformers and GIS switchgear.
  • Are familiar with industrial layout design, routing, 3D modelling, structural and weight estimation of high voltage components, preferably on Offshore Substations
  • Have experience with interface management across systems
  • Possess excellent communication skills in English

As a person you are a natural team player and collaborator who enjoy working across many business areas. You have a strong drive and desire to continually develop high quality solutions in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills to come up with efficient ways to solve obstacles.

You are born curious and have a positive mindset.

The position is full time and your work location can be either at our office in Copenhagen, Esbjerg or Gdynia. You should expect up to 10-30 travel days annually.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Head of Solution Engineering, PLM – Jesper S. Rytke +45 2721 9705.

title: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:
  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.
  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
  • Develop new recipes and food products.
  • Work with food safety and quality control.
  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:
  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.
  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:
  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
  • Can communicate in English.
  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions
The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.
Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):
Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR
1st year per month 13.708 1.835
2nd year per month 17.343 2.321
Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743
Adult apprentice per month 26.839 3.593
  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month
  • Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.
  • Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).

Your education
Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.
The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.
Ready to take the next step?
Would you like to build an international career with an award-winning company and become a skilled food craftsman in Denmark?
Send your motivated application to:
Born & Kolstrup
info@mmm-rc.dk
Learn more about us:
https://mmm-rc.dk/
Instagram:
@bornogkolstrup
Learn more about ZBC:
https://www.zbc.dk
We look forward to hearing from you! Application deadline 16/8-26

title: Farmworker piggery
description:
Farmworker with interest for piggery

  • Interests in pigs and and eager to achive knowlegde about animal wellfare

  • Have practical skills – are able to see when technical issues need to be taken care of, and best is, if you know something about technical matters ( animal care is first job)

We offer:

  • A position with influence, where you can help shape your role.

  • A workplace with skilled colleagues and a focus on well-being – for both people and animals.

  • Housing and salary according to qualifications.

  • Schooling about medication and caring about pigs

  • Free acces to swimstadions and bowling (and other activities)

  • Non smoking workplace

  • All needed workclothes ( and we wash them too)

  • Good staff kitchen, with all cooking facilities incl. free coffee, tea and hot chocloate.

About you: Interested in pigfarming, hardworking, social and english speaking. Danish class available.

About us:
We are located in 6870 Ølgod, where we have run our family farm since 1947. Our goal is to create a great place to work, where the pigs thrive and where there is room for both family and leisure time. We could tell you much more, but we would rather meet you informally to give you an insight into our way of running a modern farm/sow herd.

We look forward to welcoming you.

International enviroment with workers from different countries.

International enviroment with workers from different countries.

Our farm is a family farm, which does not only means that the farm has been owned by same family in generations, but also that working in our farm is like to work in a big family. We value working together with responsibility for each and everyone, taking care of eachother, helping each other when things get difficult. But always with first priority of animal wellfare for our pigs

We are looking for someone to join our team, who are willing to do rutine work at our farm like washing with highpressure, feeding , cleaning. When you start working here, you need to take a "Medicine Course Diploma" involving: legislation, animal welfare, disease diagnosis, use of veterinarydrugs, injection techniques, euthanasia, castration of pigs, and post mortem examination. This is a diploma paid and arrranged by our company.

We are an international farm with people employed here from 6 different countries. We expect you to talk a minimum of english and to understand even better. Your colleaques are from 20 years of age till 72 years old.

We provide living at a nearby farmhouse, where you will have your own room in a shared house.

Working hours 37 pr. week. Salary agreed depending on your skills and experience. We welcome all.

No smoking.

Work tasks: Key responsibilities

Engineering collaboration and documentation: - Work closely with electronics, optics and systems engineers. - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. - Create and maintain clear technical documentation. - Help improve software development, testing and documentation practices. - Take increasing ownership of technical tasks as your understanding of our systems develops.

We offer: What we offer:
- A hands-on engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication technologies. - Meaningful technical ownership and the opportunity to see your work move from implementation to hardware integration and validation. - Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team. - The opportunity to develop your expertise across embedded software, electronics, optics and aerospace systems. - The ability to contribute to technical decisions and engineering practices as the company grows. - A gross annual base salary of €35,000–€57,000, depending on experience, skills and the expected level of responsibility. - Relocation support to Estonia if required. - Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs. Working arrangement: This is a primarily onsite position in Tallinn, Estonia, as the role involves close collaboration with hardware, integration and testing. Limited hybrid work may be agreed depending on the employee’s responsibilities and the stage of the work. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager. Other important information: This position may require the selected candidate to be eligible to obtain government security clearance. At Golbriak Space, we use our passion for purposeful innovation to help keep people safe and solve complex engineering challenges. We foster an inclusive environment built on integrity, responsibility and employee empowerment.

title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.

Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. title: Kokk
description:
Tööülesanded: Töö toimub Adavere tuuliku juures asuvas väikeses toitlustuskohas. Tööülesandeks on toitlustuskoha iseseisev korraldamine ja igapäevase töö käigus hoidmine. Otsime universaalset ja tegusat inimest või paari, kes suudab vajadusel korraldada ettevõtte igapäevast tegevust iseseisvalt. Töö hõlmab pitsa, pasta, kebabi ja grilltoitude valmistamist ning võimalusel ka kookide, tortide ja teiste kondiitritoodete valmistamist. Samuti kuuluvad töö hulka tooraine ettevalmistamine, köögi korrashoid, klientide teenindamine ning vajadusel muud toitlustuskoha toimimiseks vajalikud ülesanded.
Ootame professionaalset ja kogenud kokka, kellel on varasem töökogemus ning head hinnangud või tagasiside tehtud töö kohta. Oluline on kõrge toiduvalmistamise kvaliteet, hea maitse ja professionaalne töösse suhtumine. Otsime inimest, kes ei piirdu ainult kokatööga, vaid on valmis vajadusel tegelema ka teiste praktiliste ülesannetega, korraldama töökorraldust, hoidma kohta korras ning leidma iseseisvalt lahendusi igapäevastes olukordades. Sobiv kandidaat on aktiivne, usaldusväärne, korrektse käitumisega ja hea suhtumisega nii töösse kui ka teistesse inimestesse. Hindame häid eluviise, vastutustundlikkust ja austavat suhtumist ühisesse töö- ja elukeskkonda. Tööajal palume isiklikku telefoni mitte kasutada, välja arvatud kiireloomulistel või tööga seotud juhtudel.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume stabiilset ja mitmekülgset tööd toitlustusvaldkonnas ning võimalust käivitada ja arendada uut toitlustuskohta. Töötasu vastavalt oskustele, kogemustele ja töö tulemustele, lisaks tulemustasu ning võimalus teenida täiendavalt vastavalt toitlustuskoha müügitulemustele ja käibele. Aktiivse ja tulemusliku töö korral on võimalik teenida rohkem. Sobivale töötajale või paarile on võimalik pakkuda majutust kõrval asuvas tuulikus, kuid majutuskoht vajab eelnevalt remontimist ja korrastamist. Hindame töökat, aktiivset, paindlikku ja iseseisvat inimest, kes on valmis võtma vastutuse toitlustuskoha toimimise eest. Talvekuudel on võimalus jätkata tööd Tenerifel ettevõtte baaris ja kohvikus. Tenerifel töötamise korral on samuti võimalik pakkuda majutust. Töötajaga sõlmitakse tööleping Property Deals OÜga ning lähetatakse.

Muud nõuded: Ootame aktiivset, töökat ja iseseisvat inimest või paari, kes oskab valmistada pitsa, pasta, kebabi ja grilltoite ning on valmis vajadusel tegelema ka teiste praktiliste ülesannetega. Töö eeldab paindlikkust, head suhtlemisoskust ja vastutustunnet.
Sobiv kandidaat on aktiivne, usaldusväärne, korrektse käitumisega ja hea suhtumisega nii töösse kui ka teistesse inimestesse. Kuna tööga võib kaasneda majutus, hindame rahulikku ja korrastatud eluviisi ning vastutustundlikku suhtumist ühisesse töö- ja elukeskkonda. Eelistame kandidaati, kes ei suitseta ega tarvita alkoholi.

Tööülesanded: Rolli kirjeldus:
Toateenindaja vastutab külalistubade, heaolualade ja ühiskasutatavate ruumide puhtuse, korra ja esindusliku välimuse tagamise eest kõrgel tasemel. See roll toetab üldist külaliskogemust, tagades, et kõik retriidi alad on puhtad, hügieenilised ning järjepidevalt esitatud vastavalt kehtivatele tööstandarditele ja protseduuridele. Pesumajandus ja voodipesu • Koguda, sorteerida ja töödelda pesu vastavalt kehtestatud protseduuridele. • Tagada voodipesu käsitlemine vastavalt majapidamise standardtööjuhenditele. Tervis, ohutus ja hügieen • Järgida kõiki töötervishoiu- ja ohutusnõudeid, sealhulgas puhastusvahendite ja -seadmete korrektset kasutamist. • Teavitada viivitamata hooldusprobleemidest, ohuteguritest või puudustest. • Hoida majapidamiskäru ja laoruumid puhtad ning korrastatud. Suhtlus ja meeskonnatöö • Suhelda tõhusalt majapidamisjuhi, majapidamise vahetusevanema ning laiema meeskonnaga. • Edastada täpselt teave tehtud tööde, pooleliolevate ülesannete ja külaliste soovide kohta. • Teha koostööd kolleegidega, et tagada sujuv igapäevane töökorraldus. • Säilitada alati professionaalne ja lugupidav käitumisviis.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie inimkultuur
EHA pakub läbimõeldud ja kõrgetasemelist töökeskkonda, mis põhineb autentsusel, hoolivusel ja isiklikul vastutusel. Väärtustame koosloomist ja vastutuse võtmist ning julgustame iga meeskonnaliiget töötama oma tugevuste ja loomuliku andekuse tsoonis. Sind toetatakse järjepideva professionaalse arengu ja koolitustega, mis panustavad sinu pikaajalisse karjääriteekonda. Töötad koos meeskonnaga, kes on pühendunud taastavale külalislahkusele – kontseptsioonile, mis on üles ehitatud teadlikkuse ja vastastikuse austuse põhimõttel seestpoolt väljapoole. Tasu ja hüved Pakume konkurentsivõimelist töötasu ja hüvesid, toetavaid töötingimusi ning meeskonnakultuuri, kus sinu panust siiralt hinnatakse. See ametikoht sobib inimesele, kes tunneb end hästi külalistele suunatud meeskonnatöös, on motiveeritud pidevast arengust ning väärtustab kuulumist meeskonda, mis on pühendunud järjepidevale täiustamisele.

Kirjalik ja suuline inglise keele oskus. Palume arvestada, et kuigi tehakse mõistlikke kohandusi, toimub kohapealne meeskonnasisene suhtlus inglise keeles. Võime töötada kõrgete puhtus- ja hügieenistandardite järgi. Hea ajaplaneerimis- ja organiseerimisoskus. Täpsus ja järjepidevus. Võime töötada iseseisvalt ning meeskonna osana. title: Embedded Software Developer, Kempower Oyj, Lahti / Tampere
description:
About the role

You will be part of a team of developers focused on firmware and embedded Linux development. The role involves balancing independent work with regular team syncs, focusing on both current product releases and the development of future platforms.

You are offered
- An opportunity to work with cutting-edge power electronics in a collaborative environment
- An opportunity to be involved in developing a next-generation charging system
- Support and guidance from experienced experts
- Flexible remote work
- Epassi lunch deduction

Work tasks

This role entails full-lifecycle embedded software development, from feature implementation and bug fixing to hardware integration and testing on physical power platforms.
- Develop and maintain firmware using C++ on Linux platforms.
- Implement new features for next-generation power electronics products.
- Troubleshoot and resolve bugs within the existing product platform.
- Collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure seamless system integration.
- Participate in bi-weekly Kanban cycles to prioritize development goals.
- Conduct hands-on testing of software on physical hardware at the office.

We are looking for

- Suitable UAS / University degree related to embedded development
- Some previous experience with embedded systems, C++ and Linux (e.g. from study projects)
- Fluent English communication skills
- Strong problem-solving mindset and self-driven work ethic
- Interest in power electronics and the electrification of transportation

It is meritorious if you have
- Experience using AI tools such as Claude in development
- Previous experience working with power electronics or industrial products

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Orderly
- Responsible
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Kunnossapidon suunnittelija, Agnico Eagle Finland, Kittilä

Työtehtävät

Tehtävä keskittyy rikastamon huoltoseisokkien kokonaisvaltaiseen hallintaan suunnittelusta raportointiin saakka.

- Seisokkien aikainen tilanneseuranta ja valvonta kentällä
- Raportointi suoritetuista huoltotoimenpiteistä ja niiden onnistumisesta
- Tiivis yhteistyö rikastamon tuotannon ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa

Etsimme

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on:
- Korkeakoulututkinto soveltuvalta tekniseltä alalta, kuten kone- tai prosessitekniikasta
- Vahva osaaminen teollisuuden kunnossapidon työnsuunnittelusta

Arvostamme, jos sinulla on

Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

title: Työmaan materiaalivastaava
description:
Oletko järjestelmällinen logistiikan ammattilainen, joka viihtyy dynaamisessa rakennusympäristössä ja pitää langat käsissään kovassakin kiireessä?

Etsimme työmaallemme vastuuntuntoista, oma-aloitteista ja käytännönläheistä **materiaalivastaavaa**.

Installery on erikoistunut teollisuuden projekti-, kunnossapito- ja tarkastuspalveluihin. Meidät tunnetaan laadukkaasta työnjäljestä, vahvasta ammattiosaamisesta ja asiakaslähtöisestä toimintatavasta. Asiakkuuksiimme kuuluu muun muassa kriittisen infran, uusiutuvan energian, elintarviketeollisuuden, teollisuuspesun ja korkean teknologian toimijoita. Meillä pääset työskentelemään mielenkiintoisissa ympäristöissä ja jättämään oman kädenjälkesi teollisuuden huippuosaajien rinnalla.

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

Materiaalivastaavana olet keskeisessä roolissa työmaan sujuvan arjen mahdollistajana. Vastaat siitä, että materiaalit ja tarvikkeet ovat oikeassa paikassa oikeaan aikaan, työmaalogistiikka toimii tehokkaasti ja työmaan materiaalivirrat pysyvät hallinnassa. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä työmaan eri toimijoiden kanssa varmistaaksesi, että päivittäinen työskentely etenee suunnitellusti.

Tehtävässä vastaat saapuvien tavaroiden ja materiaalien vastaanotosta, toimitusten tarkastamisesta sekä mahdollisten kuljetusvaurioiden raportoinnista. Huolehdit materiaalien purkamisesta, lastaamisesta ja siirtämisestä kurottajalla ja trukilla sekä työmaan varastoalueiden ja materiaalien järjestelmällisestä hallinnasta. Lisäksi tuet työmaan urakoitsijoita materiaalilogistiikkaan liittyvissä tarpeissa, hoidat pientarvikehankintoja ja koordinoit jätehuoltoa yhteistyössä kumppaneiden kanssa. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluu myös työmaan yleisen järjestyksen, siisteyden ja työturvallisuuden ylläpitäminen.

Kyseessä on määräaikainen tehtävä, jonka arvioitu kesto on noin 2–3 kuukautta.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

Sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta työmaalogistiikasta, varastonhallinnasta tai vastaavista tehtävistä rakennus- tai teollisuusympäristössä. Hallitset kurottajan ja trukin käytön turvallisesti ja varmoin ottein sekä omistat voimassa olevan B-luokan ajokortin pientarvikehankintoja ja noutoja varten. Työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti ja käytännönläheisesti sekä tartut toimeen nopeasti havaitessasi tarpeita tai ratkaistavia tilanteita. Toimit palveluhenkisesti ja joustavasti yhteistyössä työmaan muiden urakoitsijoiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa. Pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja tekemään päätöksiä nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Suomen kielen lisäksi hallitset englannin kielen siinä määrin, että pystyt kommunikoimaan sujuvasti kansainvälisellä työmaalla.

**Miksi Installery?**

Meillä työskentelet avoimessa, työntekijälähtöisessä ja ammattimaisessa työyhteisössä, jossa osaamista arvostetaan ja kehitetään aktiivisesti.

Tarjoamme:

- Vastuullisen, monipuolisen ja itsenäisen roolin yhdellä modernimmista ja mielenkiintoisimmista rakennustyömaista.

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä ja vaikuttaa suoraan työmaan sujuvuuteen ja siisteyteen.

- Nykyaikaiset ja turvalliset työvälineet sekä kaluston tehtävän hoitamiseen.


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi hakulomakkeemme kautta pikimmiten. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja pyrimme palaamaan sinulle mahdollisimman nopeasti.

Jos jokin jäi pohdituttamaan, voit olla yhteydessä Talent & Operations Coordinator Heidiin: **heidi@instrallery.fi**.

title: HR-suunnittelija
description:
Etsitkö monipuolista HR-tehtävää, jossa pääset tukemaan esihenkilöitä, ratkomaan henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä ja työskentelemään erilaisten HR-prosessien ja järjestelmien parissa? Tässä tehtävässä saat vastuullesi vaihtelevia kokonaisuuksia ja pääset myös kehittämään yhteisiä toimintatapoja yhdessä muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Haemme nyt HR-suunnittelijaa Helsingin kaupunginkansliaan vakituiseen tehtävään. Tehtävän aloitus 1.10. tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Mitä pääset tässä roolissa tekemään?

Työpäiväsi HR-suunnittelijana koostuvat henkilöstöhallinnon neuvonnasta, päätösvalmistelusta, koordinoinnista ja kehittämisestä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä esihenkilöiden, HR-asiantuntijoiden ja kaupungin yhteisten palveluiden kanssa.

Tehtävässäsi:

- neuvot esihenkilöitä henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksissä ja autat heitä löytämään oikeat toimintatavat ja palvelut

- käsittelet HR:lle tulevia henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä ja ohjaat niitä tarvittaessa oikeille asiantuntijoille

- valmistelet kaupunginkanslian ylimmän johdon henkilöstöhallintoon liittyviä päätöksiä ja huolehdit niiden etenemisestä palkanmaksuun

- tuet esihenkilöitä työaikajärjestelmän ja työaikakäytäntöjen käytössä sekä vastaat työaika- ja ylityöraportoinnista palkanmaksun aikataulujen mukaisesti

- osallistut työaikajärjestelmän kehittämiseen osana kaupunkitasoista yhteistyötä

- hoidat henkilöstöhallinnon prosesseja, jotka liittyvät esimerkiksi A1-todistuksiin, siviilipalvelukseen ja palvelusvuosiin

- toimit tarvittaessa Workday-pääkäyttäjän sijaisena

- osallistut HR-tiimin yhteiseen kehittämiseen sekä kokousten ja tilaisuuksien koordinointiin.

Tehtävässä menestymisen eväät

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos innostut käytännönläheisestä HR-työstä ja erilaisten henkilöstöhallinnon kysymysten ratkomisesta. Toivomme, että sinulla on:

- Kokemusta henkilöstöhallinnon tehtävistä tai henkilöstöprosesseista. Työehtosopimusten ja työlainsäädännön tulkitseminen ei aiheuta sinulle harmaita hiuksia - jos KVTES ja kunta-ala ovat sinulle entuudestaan tuttuja, olemme erityisen vaikuttuneita!

- Kykyä selvittää henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä itsenäisesti ja soveltaa osaamistasi erilaisissa tilanteissa. Tartut uusiinkin kysymyksiin rohkeasti ja etsit niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.

- Kykyä hallita useita samanaikaisia tehtäviä ja organisoida omaa työtäsi. Pidät langat käsissäsi ja huolehdit siitä, että sovitut asiat etenevät loppuun asti.

- Selkeä ja sujuva tapa viestiä. Osaat sanoittaa henkilöstöhallinnon asioita ymmärrettävästi eri kohderyhmille ja neuvot esihenkilöitä luontevasti erilaisissa tilanteissa.

- Mutkaton tapa tehdä yhteistyötä. Autat mielelläsi muita, jaat osaamistasi ja arvostat avointa kommunikointia.

- Sujuvaa digiosaamista ja valmiutta ottaa haltuun uusia HR-järjestelmiä. Workday-HR-järjestelmän tuntemus ja kokemus työaikajärjestelmistä ovat tässä tehtävässä plussaa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto sekä suomen kielen erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Pääset osaksi osaavaa, palvelualtista ja rempseää HR-tiimiä, jossa yhdeksänhenkinen porukka tukee ja auttaa sinua onnistumaan työtehtävissäsi. Joustoa työn tekemiseen tarjoaa liukuva työaika ja mahdollisuus etätyöskentelyyn - teemme töitä monipaikkaisesti, mutta iloitsemme erityisesti kohdatessamme toimistollamme. Viihtyisät toimitilamme sijaitsevat historiaa havisevassa kaupungintalon korttelissa.

Tehtävän määritelty peruspalkka on 3498,42 e/kk + KVTES:in mukainen työkokemuslisä 3 tai 8 %. Helsingin kaupungin työntekijänä saat myös runsaasti erilaisia henkilöstöetuja. Kaupunki tarjoaa muun muassa laadukkaita työterveyshuollon palveluja, henkilöstökassan jäsenyyden, runsaasti liikkumiseen ja vapaa-aikaan liittyviä etuja sekä kaupunkipyörä- ja työsuhdematkalippuedun. Suurena työnantajana tarjoamme monia mahdollisuuksia ammattitaidon kehittämiseen, kuten kattavan koulutustarjonnan sekä monenlaisia urapolkuja.

Innostuitko?

Tartu rohkeasti tilaisuuteen ja jätä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 31.8.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat henkilöstöpäällikkö Taru Wickströmiltä (+358504331004) Parhaiten saat Tarun kiinni joko ke 18.8. klo 13.30-15.30 tai pe 21.8. klo 13.30-15.30.

You will be ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance are documented, monitored and maintained. You will also be driving continuous improvement in all areas of HSE.

The Nordic OU HSE Team is a network of experienced health, safety and environmental professionals supporting the delivery of complex construction, energy and industrial projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark. We support highly skilled site teams in delivering world-class projects through professionalism, quality and operational excellence, creating environments where safety is the natural outcome of doing the job right. Working closely with project management, customers and contractors, we provide expertise and practical support throughout the project lifecycle. Our focus is on enabling disciplined planning, effective risk management and high-quality execution that protects people, enhances performance and strengthens project outcomes.

Our strength lies in our people. We bring together talented professionals with experience from the energy sector, industrial construction and major infrastructure projects. We value expertise, integrity and a willingness to take initiative. We are a team that shares knowledge openly, learns from each other and works together to solve challenges in demanding project environments. We welcome individuals from diverse professional backgrounds who are motivated by continuous development and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

We believe that excellence comes from combining technical competence with personal accountability. We encourage constructive challenge, transparent communication and the confidence to speak up when improvements can be made. By maintaining high professional standards and supporting one another, we help project teams achieve results while protecting people, the environment and the long-term success of our projects.

We challenge established practices and continuously look for better ways to manage risk, support project teams and improve performance. Through innovation, digitalization and intelligent use of technology, we advance how decisions are made and how projects are executed. We do not simply adapt to change; we actively shape the future of HSE by turning new ideas into practical solutions that enable safer, smarter and more efficient project delivery.

If you are motivated by complex projects, enjoy working with skilled professionals and want to help shape the future of HSE in the energy and construction industries, you will fit right in with our team.

**How you'll make an impact**

- Implement and work with continuous improvement of Hitachi Energy operating unit management system and local requirements in Finland for the operating unit of the Nordic OU.

- Prepare and update HSE documentation in accordance with the internal process. Submit all preliminary HSE plans to the customer in accordance with the tender submission dates.

- Attend clarification meetings and workshops with the customer (both in person and remotely).

- Prepare the Project HSE Plan as well as other HSE-related documentation such as the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan.

- Ensure activities under the scope of Hitachi Energy are in compliance with legal and contractual HSE requirements as well as internal HSE requirements.

- Produce reports for Project Reviews, both internal and customer, and attend the Project Review meetings to ensure the Hitachi Energy HSE Operating System remains suitable, adequate, and effective.

- Review HSE documentation from all Hitachi Energy subcontractors and support subcontractors to meet internal and Project HSE requirements.


**Your background**

- Previous experience of HSE tasks in projects

- Professional HSE certification is seen as a plus

- Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certifications

- Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to operate within global teams

- Self-driven and persistent attitude towards challenges. You work actively and professionally both independently and as a part of a team.

- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and Finnish. Swedish is seen as a plus.

title: Senior Project Planner
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

Hitachi Energy is looking for a Senior Project Planner to join our Project Controls team within the Nordic Operating Unit of our Grid Integration business. The position is based in Vaasa, Finland or Västerås, Sweden, with hybrid working possibilities.

As a Senior Project Planner, you will play a critical role throughout the entire lifecycle of our most complex electrical substation projects, from tendering to project handover in the field of planning and scheduling. Your expertise and proactive approach will ensure consistency and alignment of scope, time, cost, and progress, ultimately contributing to the success and satisfaction of our customers.

In this role, you will be in the driving seat, ensuring projects have robust, dynamic, and well-structured schedules that meet contractual objectives and provide clear roadmaps for the execution phase.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust, dynamic project schedules that align with contractual commitments and provide a clear framework for successful project execution.

You will work closely with various stakeholders making sure the project schedules are used for work coordination, predictable forecasting, proactive schedule risk management, cost management, resource management, and of course, team alignment. You will also conduct schedule and resource analysis and prepare schedule progress reporting materials both for external and internal purposes.

At Hitachi Energy, we know that great results are achieved together. As a Senior Project Planner, you will collaborate closely with Project Managers, Project Controllers, Lead Engineers, Project SCMs, Logistic Specialists, Site and Commissioning Managers and with our Customers. You will also become part of a highly experienced and supportive community of Project Planners. Together, we share knowledge, solve challenges, and support one another in delivering excellence in every project.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Take a leading role in planning and scheduling activities in complex projects and support project teams with schedule governance, analysis and decision making

· Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules in close collaboration with project teams

· Support predictable schedule forecasting by aligning time, cost, resources and progress

· Identify schedule deviations, risks, and opportunities early, and communicate them clearly to project stakeholders

· Prepare schedule reports and analyses, including S-curves, critical path analyses, resource histograms and On-Time-Delivery (OTD) milestones

· Actively communicate schedule information to stakeholders to keep everyone informed

· Support and prepare What-if schedule scenarios, delay mitigation plans and Extension of Time (EoT) claims together with the project team

· Promote planning and scheduling best practices across the organization, act as a role model and support less experienced planners

· Drive the use and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling methodologies and tools

**Your background**

· M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical engineering or another relevant field

· Proven experience in planning and scheduling complex projects

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and inspire stakeholders across the project organization

· Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and good knowledge of schedule management theory

· The ability to prepare and maintain high quality, dynamic project schedules together with the project team

· A proactive and self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

· A structured and goal-oriented approach to your work, with a focus on delivering results

· Project Management Certificate (PMP® and/or PMI-SP®) is considered an advantage

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish is considered a plus

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
What if your next role would let you shape user experiences at the core of Finlands financial infrastructure?

Were looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our New Business -team in Euroclear Finlands IT department for a permanent position.

This position suits a developer who values engineering excellence, meaningful impact, and professional autonomy, and who enjoys solving complex problems in a stable but continuously evolving environment contributing to systems that are critical to the Finnish and Nordic financial markets.

Your responsibilities

In this role, youll build and operate modern, long-lived systems where quality, reliability, and security are critical. Working closely with other developers, architects, product owners, and UX designers, youll deliver secure and scalable full-stack solutions, from user interfaces to backend services and deployment pipelines. Your work will support business-critical systems used daily by key market participants in a highly regulated financial environment.

In this role you will

Design and build modern user interfaces with focus on usability, accessibility, performance

Design and develop full stack software that fulfils functional and non-functional requirements.

Implement necessary APIs, integrations, data flows.

Take ownership of end-to-end delivery (design -> build -> test -> deploy -> operate)

Develop and maintain automated tests

Ensure performance, security, and reliability of solutions

Work with container platforms and Linux-based runtime environments both on-premises and in cloud.

Apply engineering best practices (maintainable code, reviews, CI/CD, documentation)

Collaborate with product, UX, architecture and development teams

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a generalist software developer with a strong front-end mindset, who combines technical skills with a genuine interest in user experience and quality delivery.

- At least 5 years of hands-on experience in front-end development (React, TypeScript)
- Proven ability to build high-quality, user-centric interfaces in collaboration with UX/service designer
- Solid backend development skills (Java / Spring Boot)
- Knowledge of secure software development practices
- Experience with APIs and integrations
- Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright (or similar)
- Understanding of testing strategies and quality engineering
- Experience with containers and Linux runtime environments
- Strong problem-solving skills and an ownership-driven approach
- Good communication skills and fluency in English. Our working language is English. Fluency in Finnish is considered an advantage.
- Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams.

Nice to have

- Experience in financial or regulated environment
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (e.g. Azure)

We are open to different experience levels and value both strong hands-on expertise and a growth mindset. While this role offers support and collaboration, it requires enough practical experience to work independently and take ownership for your own deliverables from an early stage.

Why join us

Join Euroclear and play a key role at the very heart of the global, Nordic, and Finnish financial markets. As a trusted backbone connecting over 2,000 financial institutions worldwide, Euroclear safeguards the stability of the worlds capital markets, while our Helsinki office anchors critical infrastructure for Finlands financial system.

Despite our global reach, Euroclear Finland is a close-knit, local team where everyone quickly gets to know each other. Here, your ideas matter and your initiatives are valued by supportive leadership. We take pride in running the financial world safely and reliably, but above all, we are people working for people, valuing care, collaboration, and integrity every day.

What We Offer

Meaningful work with real impact

Build secure, reliable, and high-performance solutions that support critical market infrastructure.

Stability and modernisation

Work on business-critical systems while contributing to modern technologies and continuous development.

Strong tech community

Collaborate with experienced architects, developers, and domain experts who value quality and continuous improvement.

Modern ways of working

Enjoy a well-equipped Ruoholahti office, a hybrid model (3 days on-site, 2 remote), and a culture that supports learning and collaboration.

Wellbeing and benefits

We offer regular office breakfasts, a paid volunteering day, comprehensive occupational healthcare, and flexible wellbeing benefits covering sports, culture, transport, massage, dental care, and lunch.

How to apply

Ready to take the next step in your career?

Please submit your application, CV, and salary request directly to our Careers database by 14 September 2026. You may also include a link to your GitHub profile. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on a rolling basis.

For further inquiries, please contact our recruitment partner Arja Martikainen, Barona arja.martikainen(at)barona.fi.

Start date is negotiable but preferably in October 2026.

About Euroclear Finland

Euroclear group is a global provider of Financial Market Infrastructure (FMI) services.At the core, the group provides settlement, safe-keeping and servicing of domestic and cross-border securities for bonds, equities and derivatives to investment funds. The Euroclear group has multi-lingual, highly trained teams of professionals based in Europe, Asia, the Middle East and the Americas. The Euroclear group has +2 400 clients globally, settled the equivalent of EUR 1 072 trillion in securities transactions in 2023, representing 299 million domestic and cross-border transactions and held an average of EUR 37.7 trillion in assets for clients.

For more information about Euroclear Finland, please visit www.euroclear.fi or visit our group site www.euroclear.com

title: Autonasentaja / Ajoneuvoasentaja monipuolisiin huolto- ja korjaustehtäviin, Kuopion Yritysautohuolto, Kuopio
description:
Autonasentaja – Kuopion Yritysautohuolto

Työn kuvaus

Haemme **kokenutta autonasentajaa Kuopion Yritysautohuoltoon** vahvistamaan ja kehittämään yritysautojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluamme.

Kuopion Yritysautohuolto keskittyy yritysten **henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huoltoon, korjaukseen ja vianetsintään**. Asiakkaidemme ajoneuvot ovat pääasiassa päivittäisessä ammattikäytössä, joten meille on tärkeää saada autot huollettua ja korjattua laadukkaasti ja sujuvasti takaisin liikenteeseen.

Etsimme asentajaa, jolla on **3–5 vuoden tai pidempi käytännön kokemus autonasentajan työstä** ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti erilaisten huolto-, korjaus- ja vianetsintätehtävien parissa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa

- henkilö- ja pakettiautojen määräaikaishuollot

- jarru- ja alustakorjaukset

- moottori- ja voimansiirtoon liittyvät korjaukset

- vianetsintä ja diagnostiikka

- ajoneuvojen sähkövikojen selvittäminen

- lisälaitteiden ja varusteiden asennukset

- muut monipuoliset autokorjaamon huolto- ja korjaustyöt


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Toivomme sinulta:

- **3–5 vuoden tai pidempää kokemusta autonasentajan työstä**

- monipuolista käytännön osaamista henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- kokemusta vianetsinnästä ja diagnostiikasta

- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

- B-ajokorttia


Kokemus pakettiautoista, hyötyajoneuvoista ja ajoneuvosähköstä katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme **monipuolisen työn ja mahdollisuuden tulla mukaan kehittämään Kuopion Yritysautohuollon toimintaa**.

Taustalla on toimiva korjaamo, valmis yritysasiakaskunta ja pitkä kokemus yritysten kaluston huolto- ja korjaustöistä. Yritysautohuoltoa kehitämme omana palvelukokonaisuutenaan, ja haemme siihen nyt osaavaa autonasentajaa.

Työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti huolto-, korjaus-, diagnostiikka- ja vianetsintätöitä eri automerkkien parissa.

Korjaamossamme huolletaan ja korjataan myös muuta yritysasiakkaiden kalustoa, joten toimintaympäristö on tavallista autokorjaamoa monipuolisempi.

Työtä on mahdollista tehdä **kokoaikaisessa tai osa-aikaisessa palkkatyösuhteessa**. Myös työskentelystä kevyt- tai sopimusyrittäjänä voidaan sopia erikseen.

**Palkkaus sovitaan kokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella.**

Hakeminen

Lähetä hakemus ja kerro lyhyesti aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi, osaamisestasi sekä siitä, millaisten autojen ja korjaustöiden parissa olet työskennellyt.

Voit myös soittaa ja kysyä tehtävästä lisää.

**Jos olet kokenut autonasentaja ja etsit monipuolista työtä yritysasiakkaiden kaluston parissa, ota yhteyttä.**

title: Raskaan kaluston päälirakenne asentaja ja korjaaja
description:
Haemme joukkoomme tekijää, joka ei säikähdä työntekoa ja haluaa nähdä oman kädenjälkensä valmiissa lopputuloksessa. Jos pysyvät työkalut kädessä ja kiinnostus tekniikkaan löytyy, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Työtehtävät liittyvät monipuolisesti raskaan kaluston varusteluun, huoltoon, asennuksiin ja teknisiin ratkaisuihin. Päivät eivät ole samanlaisia, ja työ tarjoaa sopivasti haastetta sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä ammattilaisena.

Sinulta toivomme

- oma-aloitteista ja reipasta asennetta

- kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- halua oppia uutta

- käytännönläheistä otetta tekemiseen


Iso plussa on, jos hallitset

- hitsauksen

- **Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen työhön**

- **Ammattitaitoisen ja tiiviin työyhteisön**

- **Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa opasosaamistasi kasvavassa yrityksessä**


**TYÖSUHDE**

Työsuhde on määräaikainen talvisesongin ajalle marraskuusta 2026 maaliskuun 2027 loppuun.

Mahdollisuus työllistyä jo syys-lokakuuksi revontuliretkille mönkijöillä.

Työ on osa-aikainen ja työvuoroja on sesongin ilta-aikaan sekä viikonloppuisin. Mahdollisuus tehdä halutessaan myös päiväsafareita tarvittaessa. sekä pidempiä muutaman viikon pätkiä täysillä viikko tunneilla. Työmäärä vaihtelee varaustilanteen mukaan.

title: Chief Designer / Project manager (MSP)
description:
Already into our seventh year of operations providing technical consulting services in Finland and offshored in India, the MSP-concept (Managed Service Provider) keeps proving its merits. As a result we have with our operationally established account within wood processing machinery in Lahti region an intriguing engineering position for you. Leveraging your mechanical design discipline experience preferably with special purpose machines (SPM) why not take on the challenge of leading this order-based mechanical design service with us? Like the job title implies the job role is two-pronged. You are the Project Manager making sure our service commitment as a whole both develops in the direction outlined and with deliverables meeting requirements pre-defined together with the customer. Further the role holds a Chief Designer element requiring hands-on interaction with project managers and chief designers for securing relevant design kick-off data to be then diced and sliced between your design team members in Finland and India. After successful ramp-up work can partly be done remotely. The assignment is also suitable for a freelance entrepreneur part of our supplier network.

We expect of you:

-relevant M.Sc./B.Sc.mechanical engineering degree.

- 5+ years relevant 3D CAD design (preferably PLM context by PTC) work experience and preferably within wood processing machinery (or other SPM).

- proven track from leading as Chief Engineer design-to-order team activities and members or strong aptitude for assuming the role.

- good intra-stakeholder English written and oral communicating skills while some Finnish skills is a competitive advantage.

- and of course, the ability to work independently and at times on simultaneous projects under the occasional time pressure.

We offer you:

- career-wise an inspiring vantage point in the design team of a leading global technology industry player.

- an opportunity to leave your own mark as member of the project delivery process while adding a strong reference in your competence portfolio.

- an exciting role contributing to the dynamic growth of our international MSP service.

- a competitive, encouraging salary closely mirroring your performance as well as the devoted support of ECHO Engineering management.

On fire? Please submit your application and CV ASAP as we are interviewing candidates as they come in! Inquiries also directly by phone.


ECHO Engineering

Echo Engineering Oy was established in 2019 to respond to the fluctuating demand for commission-based technical professionals in the technology industry. For our parent company, Kaiku HR, this direction is a natural step towards offering a more comprehensive skill palette for the clients. To chosen clients we not only offer local technical consulting services, but also flexible remote design capacity out of India or bring technical experts to Finland for assignments.
Combining our capabilities, we can offer services that correspond to the high Finnish quality standards in a competitive price range.

Our key personnel have 20 years of experience in the field: Mats Lindholms expertise lies in supply of local hourly based salaried or freelance engineers of varying discipline. Anil Talwan has a strong portfolio of selling, organizing, and executing remote designing services between Finland and India.

Kaiku HR (www.kaikuhr.fi) is an industrial staffing and recruitment company, finding the right skill for the right place. We know finding the right, motivated expert also guarantees the satisfaction of the client company. Our honest and compassionate policies translate into strong mutual respect, honesty, and reliability. In 2025 group revenue was approximately €21.4 million. Over the years, we have successfully recruited thousands of professionals both in Finland and internationally. We are members of The Private Employment Agencies Association (HELA) and follow the common practices and general terms and conditions of the field.

title: Guide
description:
Activity Guide

We are now looking for an **Activity Guide** to join our team. In this role, you will be at the heart of our international activity operations – safely guiding our guests through unique nature experiences and contributing to the development of our activity services.

What we offer

- Meaningful work with one of the pioneers of tourism in Lapland, where sustainability and quality are at the heart of everything we do.

- An inspiring working environment: in your free time, you can enjoy the peace and beauty of Laplands nature – skiing, hiking, fishing or watching the Northern Lights.

- The support of an encouraging work community: you will work in an international environment with the warm and relaxed atmosphere of a family-owned company.

- A wide range of staff benefits and opportunities for personal and professional development.

- Staff accommodation can be arranged if needed.


Your responsibilities

- Safely and professionally guiding guests on a variety of activities, such as snowshoeing, snowmobile safaris, Northern Lights excursions and ice fishing.

- Ensuring excellent guest experiences through warm, clear communication and professional service.

- Preparing equipment and maintaining activity areas.

- Working in the equipment storage and service area.

- Following safety guidelines and company procedures.

- Supporting the development of activity products and daily operations.

- Reporting to the Activity Manager.


Who are we looking for?

You are responsible, proactive and passionate about the outdoors and customer service. You enjoy seasonal work where no two days are exactly the same and thrive in an international environment.

You have:

- Solid experience in guiding or outdoor activities; previous experience in Lapland is considered an advantage.

- Good physical fitness and a safety-first mindset.

- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

- Excellent communication and customer service skills.

- Fluency in English; other language skills, such as Finnish, German or French, are considered an advantage.

- A valid Category B driving licence.

- A willingness to learn and develop your skills.


Ready for an adventure?

If you have a passion for nature, adventure and creating unforgettable guest experiences, you might be the person we are looking for.

**Start date:** Late November.

If this sounds like you and you are interested in joining our team, send us your application and CV. We would love to hear from you!

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris is a family-owned pioneer of tourism in Lapland, located in Muonio in Fell Lapland, close to the Swedish border. Founded in 1973 as a camping and caravan site on the banks of the Tornio–Muonio River, Europes longest free-flowing river, Harriniva has grown into three full-service resorts surrounded by the pristine nature of Lapland.

Today, Harriniva Hotels & Safaris consists of **Harriniva Adventure Resort**, **Jeris Lakeside Resort** and **Torassieppi Eco Reindeer Resort**.

Every day, our team works to deliver on our promise: **Best in Wilderness**. At Harriniva, we do our utmost to ensure that every guest experiences the unique nature of Lapland in an unforgettable way – taking home lasting memories and the feeling of being at their best in the wilderness.
