title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

1.    Prašymą leisti dalyvauti atrankoje.

6.    Pedagoginių ir psichologinių žinių kursų išklausymo dokumento kopiją (jei asmuo neturi pedagogo kvalifikacijos).
7.    Rekomendacijas iš buvusių darboviečių (neprivaloma, pateikiama pretendento iniciatyva).

Dokumentų pateikimo tvarka ir terminai:
Pretendentai dokumentus pristato asmeniškai (mokyklos adresu), siunčia registruotu laišku arba elektroniniu paštu: mokykla@panmm.lt iki 2026 m. rugpjūčio 24 d. 14.00 val.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

SEB Luxembourg branch serves as the hub for Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO) services to Nordic nationals living abroad. PWM&FO offers comprehensive banking services, access to capital markets, financing solutions and individually tailored advisory services. The advisory services are based on SEB's vast range of financing and investment products.

Dynamic and international working environment

description:

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve.

We are looking for a skilled IT Security Expert with strong hands-on network administration expertise to join our dynamic IT Security team.
The role combines IT Security Infrastructure management with deep operational knowledge of enterprise network infrastructures, ensuring that security controls are effectively implemented, and operated across on premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
The successful candidate will work as part of the ITS Group Function – Network & Security Team in Quintet Luxembourg.

Key Accountabilities

• Operate the Bank Security Infrastructure (Run the Bank) including firewall policies, VPNs, IPS/IDS, and mail gateways.
• Penetration Testing Coordination: Coordinate and support penetration testing efforts, analysing findings, and working with teams to address identified security weaknesses.
• Vulnerabilities Process Follow-Up: Monitor and track the status of identified vulnerabilities, ensuring that remediation efforts are executed efficiently and effectively. Manage the process and provide reporting associated
• Patching Follow-Up: Manage and oversee the patch management process including EDR follow up, ensuring timely application of security updates and addressing vulnerabilities in a proactive manner.
• Security Dashboard Creation: Develop and maintain security dashboards to provide real-time visibility into security metrics, vulnerabilities, and incident response efforts for stakeholders
• Operate the day to day data leakage prevention (DLP) and data exfiltration monitoring activities, including detection, investigation, and remediation of potential data leaks across network, endpoint, cloud, and perimeter layers.
• Technical Risk Analysis Support: Assist in conducting technical risk assessments and analyses to identify potential security threats and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
• Access Validation: provide guidance for specific access request by following Access control policy principles
• Maintain and secure the group network infrastructure, including Lan, Wan, SD-WAN, VPN, Bank Wireless network and cloud networking.  
• Ensure secure connectivity between on-premises environments and cloud platforms
• Collaboration: Work closely with IT teams, including CISO, to integrate security into all aspects of the organization's IT landscape.    
    
Knowledge and Experience

• 5+ years of experience in IT Security, with strong hands-on experience in enterprise network administration.
• Strong knowledge of security frameworks and best practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001).
• Proven experience in network and security operations within complex environments.
• Experience with penetration testing methodologies and tools.
• Familiarity with security technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, and SIEM solutions.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CEH, CISM, CCNP Security, etc) are highly desirable.  
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Attributes and Qualities

• Adaptability & Learning Agility                        
• Time Management                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                    
• Client-Centric Mindset                            
• Collaborative Teamwork

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge in Security Frameworks and Standards. Knowledge of security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls) and Compliance regulations (GDPR, DORA, etc)
• Strong knowledge Firewall Next Generation (VPN, IPS, Anti-malware, Sandbox, URL Filtering, ...); Mail & Web gateways;
• Knowledge in VPN and Remote access solutions
• Knowledge in Endpoints Security (antivirus, antimalware)
• Knowledge in Threat Intelligence and Vulnerability Management - Ability to analyse threat intelligence and conduct vulnerability assessments. Familiarity with security tools (SIEM, vulnerability scanners).  

Languages Skills

• Excellent written and oral French and English skills are essential, any other language is an advantage

title: Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation (m/f)
description:
Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

title: Banking Operations Officer (Fixed-term 24 months) (m/f)
employer: Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG, succursale de Luxembourg S.A.E.
description:
Career Opportunities: Banking Operations Officer (Fixed-term 24 months) (124470)
Requisition ID 124470 - Posted 31/07/2026 - Luxembourg - Luxembourg - Activity area (1) - Experienced Professionals

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Technology & Operations design and integrate software applications ranging from portfolio management systems, trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group's key innovations while sustaining business operations and developing custodian and funds administration services.

This function is in the Clients & Assets Services department, in the Asset Data Management unit.

Your role

As a Banking Operations Officer, you will be responsible for overseeing the opening and pricing of a diverse range of financial products. This includes a wide scope of assets, such as listed products (equities, bonds, loans, derivatives), OTC products (IRS, CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD), and structured products (autocall, reverse convertible, dual currency deposits, accumulators, airbags). You will manage the entire workflow, from trade reception and integration into the bank's database, through lifecycle management, to instrument pricing.

Another aspect of the role will be to manage our complex platform and its development, working closely with our Product Analyst.

• Integrate and control asset openings on our global platform, Neoxam.
• Monitor and publish asset data, prices, Greeks, market data, and analytics across all supported platforms.
• Manage the lifecycle of all assets from an asset data perspective (Corpac events, openings, unwinds).
• Provide support to various users of this data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).
• Challenge various asset types against counterparty prices.
• Liaise directly with key stakeholders in case of issues.
• Implement the necessary configurations for queries and data/pricing flows for newly registered securities from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).
• Regularly review and update these settings.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master's degree in Finance, economics.
• 2 to 5 years' experience minimum in a similar position with a strong understanding of financial products and market structures.

Hard skills:

• Strong understanding on financial products.
• Solid technical skills, particularly with data management tools and financial platforms.
• Background in mathematical finance.
• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel.
• Programming skills: VBA, SQL or another language is an asset.

Soft skills:

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects with versatility in a dynamic environment.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with various teams and stakeholders.
• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.
• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.
• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution.

Language skills:

• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

title: GBL Strategy Specialist, Global Medical Accommodations (m/f)
description:
GBL Strategy Specialist, Global Medical Accommodations
Job ID: 10485960 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Medical Accommodations Global Relations & Strategy Specialist is a specialized individual contributor role within Global Medical Accommodations (GMA), created to align ROW stakeholders to our global strategy, ways of working, and technology direction - while ensuring their legitimate concerns are heard, addressed, or escalated decisively. A key objective of this role is to help GMA progress toward global parity between the US and all other regions, ensuring ROW associates and business partners receive a consistent, high-quality accommodations experience.

This role operates as a strategic stakeholder advocate and internal change agent - listening deeply to regional business concerns, evangelizing the global accommodations mission, having backbone when stakeholder requests conflict with global strategy, and bridging divides where local legal requirements demand differentiation. The specialist owns the overarching program direction and strategy for ROW stakeholder alignment, but executes through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES teams, Technology, and others as required.

Key job responsibilities

Stakeholder Advocacy & Strategic Alignment

Serve as the primary point of alignment between ROW stakeholders and GAA's global strategy, building deep understanding of regional business concerns while driving adoption of global ways of working and technology direction.
Evangelize the global accommodations mission and technology strategy to ROW stakeholders, building understanding and buy-in for the direction even when it challenges local preferences or established practices.
Exercise backbone: where stakeholder concerns conflict with global strategy and are not legally required, push back respectfully, bring stakeholders on board with the rationale, or escalate with a clear recommendation.
Where stakeholder concerns are valid - aligned to global policy or driven by local legal requirements - identify gaps and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure they are addressed through the Global Parity program or technology roadmap.
Identify and surface emerging stakeholder concerns proactively (e.g., self-service models driving unintended volume in EU markets, insufficient medical documentation friction creating compliance risk), working with relevant teams to close gaps before they escalate.
Treat stakeholders as customers: understand their needs, close the loop on their concerns, and drive accountability for resolution.
Propose and implement mechanisms to measure stakeholder satisfaction - addressing the current gap where manager and business partner experience with accommodation services is not systematically captured.
Provide structured, data-backed updates to stakeholders on initiatives and concerns they have raised - keeping them informed, engaged, building trust through transparency and follow-through.

Service Adoption & Awareness

Develop and drive a global strategy to increase adoption of GMA services across ROW countries.
Partner with country operations and HR teams to understand barriers to service utilization, and work with relevant teams to remove friction and increase awareness.
Track adoption metrics by country and region, surfacing gaps and recommending targeted interventions to close them.

Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Execution

Own the overarching ROW stakeholder alignment program and strategic direction, executing through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES, Ops Center of Excellence, business policy/standard work teams, Technology, Legal, and Expansions.
Partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure ROW stakeholder needs inform parity priorities. Validate that parity deliverables address field concerns and drive stakeholder adoption of implemented solutions. This role does not own the Global Parity program - it serves as the voice of ROW stakeholders into that program.
Identify ROW-specific technology needs and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure these are reflected in the technology roadmap and product requirements.
Facilitate cross-functional working groups and governance forums, establishing clear decision rights, escalation pathways, and accountability mechanisms across all stakeholder teams.

Process Improvement and Standardization

Conduct structured current-state analyses and future-state mapping, engaging cross-functional teams to validate findings and build alignment on solutions before scaling.
Facilitate process improvement initiatives across ROW regions, identifying fragmentation and inconsistency in accommodation workflows and partnering with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader and operational teams to drive resolution.
Monitor regional performance against defined GMA expectations and metrics that are important to the business - including new metrics where existing measures do not capture stakeholder or operational reality.

Senior Leadership Engagement & Escalation Management

Build and maintain productive relationships with senior leaders across Operations, PXT, Legal, and WHS - ensuring they are informed, engaged, and aligned on accommodation strategy for their regions.

Draft and deliver structured communications, leadership briefings, and status updates that are concise, data-backed, and appropriate for executive audiences, including contributions to the business's Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Monthly Business Review (MBR) mechanisms as required.

Proactively surface cross-regional risks with proposed mitigation plans.
Exercise sound judgment in identifying when complex issues require escalation, preparing clear, data-driven problem statements, root cause analyses, and recommended actions that enable leaders to make informed decisions quickly.

Data Analysis and Insights

Analyze case data, audit findings, stakeholder feedback, and operational metrics across ROW regions to identify trends, bottlenecks, and emerging issues before they escalate into systemic problems.
Build and maintain tracking mechanisms that provide visibility into case volumes, turnaround times, adjustment types, stakeholder satisfaction, service adoption rates, and compliance adherence across the ROW network.
Use data to prioritize program initiatives, measure the impact of implemented solutions, and communicate progress to stakeholders and leadership.

Quantify the impact of stakeholder-raised concerns (e.g., volume increases attributable to self-service rollout) to inform strategic decisions on technology deployment pace and sequencing.

Regional Expansion and Change Management

Partner with the Expansions team during active country launches, focusing on post-launch adoption and ongoing stakeholder alignment rather than launch execution.
Lead change management for stakeholder adoption of GMA services and strategic initiatives this role drives, including stakeholder communications, training development, and feedback loop mechanisms that ensure adoption and continuous refinement.
Document learnings from ROW implementations and contribute to a central knowledge base that enables teams to benefit from cross-regional experience and avoid duplicating effort.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in stakeholder management, including influencing executive level global leaders
- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)
description:
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)

Luxembourg
Line of Service Advisory
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets
Specialism Fraud, Investigations & Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE)
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

Your Mission:

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;
• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles.

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;
• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;
• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities.

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;
• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;
• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists.

Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management

• Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;
• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;
• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support

• Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;
• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;
• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements.

Training and Awareness

• Deliver training sessions on financial crime compliance, including AML, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery measures;
• Promote awareness of emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Let's talk about you. If you have/are:

• Hold a university degree (minimum Bac+3) in Law, Finance, Compliance, or a related field;
• Have at least 3–5 years of experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or regulatory advisory within financial services or consulting;
• Possess strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulations, FATF standards, and global compliance frameworks;
• Bring proven experience in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud risk management, and investigations;
• Demonstrate excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex projects and multiple priorities;
• Are fluent in English and French and/or German;
• Hold certifications such as CAMS, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or equivalent, which are highly desirable.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,800 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 370,000 people in 149 countries. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting we help build, accelerate and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with DFT codes (e.g. VASP, CRYSTAL, Quantum ESPRESSO or similar), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of magnetism, ferroelectricity and/or multiferroics is a strong asset.
• You are fluent in English, both oral and written. Knowledge of French is an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do

• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce

title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

Présent dans plusieurs dizaines de pays à travers le monde, notre client est présent au Luxembourg depuis plus de  ans.Les domaines d'expertise proposés par notre client sont le droit des sociétés, le droit financier et bancaire, le droit des fonds d'investissement et du contentieux notamment. L'équipe en interne est donc très multiculturelle. Il est également important pour les membres plus expérimentés du cabinet d'apporter une formation de qualité à chaque collaborateur et cela inclut les associés qui restent disponibles à tout moment pour leur équipe quel que soit leur, ou votre, niveau d'expertise.Grâce à cela, de nombreur/euses perspectives d'apprentissage et d'évolution s'offriront à vous, afin que vous puissiez avoir une plus-value de plus en plus important/ante au sein du cabinet, et partager votre expérience avec les autres dans le futur. Vos responsabilités / Legal - Avocats - Cabinet d'Avocats - Droit - Associate Vous assurerez une relation client de qualité afin de créer une relation de confiance avec ces derniers.Vous représenterez les intérêts des structures pour lesquelles vous mettrez à bien votre expertise. Ces dernier/ières seront majoritairement des institutions financier/ières, et vous gérez la partie transactionnelle.   Vous assurerez la réalisation de différentes transactions en fournissant toute la documentation nécessaire ainsi que la négociation des contrats.  Vous assurerez une veille juridique de qualité afin d'être toujours au courant des nouvelles procédures et des services à proposer à votre clientèle. Profil et parcours / Legal - Avocats - Cabinet d'Avocats - Droit - Associate Vous avez au moins 2 ans d'expérience au sein d'un cabinet en tant qu'avocat spécialisé dans le droit bancaire et financier, en transactionnel. Si vous avez une premier/ière expérience au sein d'un cabinet international, cela représente un avantage.Vous parlez couramment le français et l'anglais afin de pouvoir assurer une communication qualitative tant avec les parties externes qu'internes au cabinet. Cela est également indispensable à la compréhension de la documentation qui sera rédigée en ces deux langues.Vous vous considérez comme une personne proactive et débordant/ante de motivation afin d'assimiler plus facilement toutes les informations qui vous seront communiquées.  Offre & avantages / Legal - Avocats - Cabinet d'Avocats - Droit - Associate En devenant avocat pour l'un des cabinets les plus réputés sur le marché, vous percevrez un salaire pouvant atteindre € bruts/an, des tickets restaurants d'une valeur de .€ ainsi qu'un bonus discrétionnaire qui vous permettra d'optimiser votre confort de vie.L'environnement très formateur duquel vous ferez partie, vous permettra, tout en apportant votre savoir, de développer votre expertise.Vous aurez la chance de travailler sur de belles transactions vous apportant, par leur complexité, des missions palpitant/antes vous permettant de rythmer considérablement vos journées.L'équipe soudée et dynamique partageant des valeurs humaines vous permettra de vous intégrer facilement. De plus, les bureaux modernes, et très bien équipés optimiseront vos conditions de travail. Le tout vous permettant de vous épanouir pleinement au quotidien.

title: Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP (H/F)
description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Afin de mieux répondre à vos enjeux, tous nos consultants sont spécialisés par secteur d'activité et zone géographique. POSTE Notre client est un acteur reconnu au Luxembourg dans le domaine des solutions SAP et de la transformation digitale. Il accompagne des entreprises de toutes tailles dans la mise en oeuvre, l'évolution et l'optimisation de leurs systèmes d'information SAP. Dans le cadre du développement de son activité et de la conduite de projets stratégiques, notre client recherche un(e) Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP afin de piloter des projets à forte valeur ajoutée et d'assurer la satisfaction de ses clients. Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'experts passionnés et évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et international. Vos missions En tant que Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP, vous serez responsable du pilotage de projets SAP, depuis leur lancement jusqu'à leur mise en production. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivant/antes : Piloter des projets SAP (implémentation, migration, montée de version et évolution) dans le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences qualité ; Assurer la coordination des équipes techniques, fonctionnelles et des différents partenaires du projet ; Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients tout au long du cycle de vie des projets ; Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins métiers afin de proposer des solutions adaptées ; Définir la gouvernance des projets, les plannings, les priorités et les indicateurs de suivi ; Identifier les risques, mettre en place les plans d'actions nécessaires et assurer leur suivi ; Garantir la qualité des livrables et le respect des engagements contractuels ; Superviser les phases de conception, développement, tests, recette, déploiement et accompagnement au changement ; Assurer le reporting auprès de la Direction et des parties prenant/antes ; Participer au développement de la relation client et identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'accompagnement. PROFIL Profil recherché Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en informatique, ingénierie ou gestion de projet, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans la gestion de projets SAP. Compétences indispensables : Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets SAP ; Excellente connaissance de l'écosystème SAP (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall ou SAP Activate) ; Expérience dans la coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires ; Bonne compréhension des processus métiers et des environnements ERP ; Excellentes capacités de communication et de gestion de la relation client. Compétences appréciées : Expérience sur des projets de migration vers SAP S/4HANA ; Connaissance de SAP BTP, SAP Fiori ou des solutions Cloud SAP ; Expérience dans des environnements internationaux ; Connaissance des bonnes pratiques ITIL ou des processus de Delivery Management. Certifications Les certifications suivant/antes constituent un réel atout : SAP Activate Project Manager ; Certifications SAP (S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP ou certification Agile/Scrum. Langues Anglais professionnel obligatoire ; La maîtrise de l'allemand constitue un réel atout ; Le français est indispensable.

title: Gestionnaire de Sites (H/F)
description: La société CforClean, dont le siège social à Windhof, est une société qui intervient depuis plus de  ans d'expérience sur le territoire luxembourgeois, qui délivre des services et prestations de nettoyage de qualité auprès des entreprises et des copropriétés au Luxembourg. La société CforClean compte plus de  collaborateurs spécialisés dans le domaine du nettoyage, et met un soin tout particulier à assurer la propreté de locaux industriels et/ou à usage de bureaux et des parties communes. Missions de nature administrative & financier/ière : Elaborer les plannings de travail des agents de nettoyage en relation avec le responsable d'exploitation et le chargé de planification,Assurer la gestion quotidien/ienne des équipes en place sur les différents sites,Encadrer et animer les équipes d'agents de nettoyage sur les différents sites,Assurer la gestion quotidien/ienne des pointages,Assurer la gestion des absences, organiser les remplacements,Gérer les besoins des agents, assurer un reporting régulier au département exploitation, participer aux entretiens de toute nature en lien avec le département ressources humaines,Assurer le suivi des nouveaux agents durant leur période d'essai (évaluation tous les  jours pendant 2 mois et demi). Missions de nature relation qualité : Traiter les réclamations, résoudre les difficultés et garantir la qualité des prestations conformément au cahier des charges du site,Auditer régulier/ièrement la qualité du site et assurer la satisfaction clients (visites régulier/ières, propositions d'amélioration, etc.). Votre profil : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en gestion d'unité ou de sites (niveau BAC à BAC+3) et justifiez d'une expérience de 2 à 5 ans minimum en entreprise de Services aux entreprises et aux particuliers et/ou entreprise opérant sur un secteur similaire ou connexe, de type PME (idéalement dans le secteur du nettoyage). Vous avez développé des capacités d'analyse, et de rigueur ; vous savez faire preuve d'organisation, d'adaptabilité, de polyvalence et de méthode dans l'exécution de vos tâches et de vos missions quotidien/iennes Vous êtes à l'aise dans tous les aspects de la gestion de site et avez idéalement une connaissance pratique des missions, enjeux et contraintes dans le domaine du nettoyage et de l'entretien. Vous disposez de solides compétences organisationnelles et êtes capable d'encadrer et de gérer quotidien/iennement des équipes en multi-sites. Flexible dans votre fonctionnement et disponible pour faire face aux contraintes d'activité, vous êtes rompu(e) aux horaires variables, savez faire preuve d'initiative, d'anticipation, d'adaptation et de réactivité face aux situations. Vous êtes de nature ouvert(e), doté(e) d'un esprit coopératif et collaboratif et êtes promoteur de l'esprit d'équipe. Vous êtes doté(e) d'une bonne aisance rédactionnelle et justifiez d'un sens avéré de la communication. Vous disposez d'un esprit dynamique, organisé et méthodique. Proactif(ve), rigoureux(se), vous vous sentez capable de vous adapter aux différentes situations ; vous êtes désireux(se) de vous investir au sein d'une entreprise dynamique, en plein développement, où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous contribuerez activement au succès. Vous maitrisez les outils informatiques usuels (pack office). Vous maitrisez la langue française (langue de travail) tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral ; la connaissance de toute langue étrangère, notamment le portugais et/ou le luxembourgeois pourra constituer un avantage. Notre offre : Intitulé du poste : Gestionnaire de sitesType de contrat : CDI - Contrat à durée indéterminéeTemps de travail : Temps partiel h/semaineJours travaillés : Du lundi au vendredi (horaires à convenir) Rémunération mensuelle brute : Salaire suivant expérience  et carburant Congés payés :  jours (au prorata du temps de travail)Le poste est à pourvoir de suite pour une prise de fonction immédiate.

title: Gestionnaire TIC (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? title: Data Scientist (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Commissariat du Gouvernement à la souveraineté des données Missions Le Commissariat du gouvernement à la souveraineté des données (« CGSD ») est une administration dont les missions sont prévues par la loi du décembre . Le CGSD peut être désigné par les administrations et les communes comme délégué à la protection des données (DPO) ou assister les DPO internes que les administrations étatiques ont désignés. Il est l'organisme compétent, conformément à l'article 7, paragraphe 1er du règlement (UE) / (règlement sur la gouvernance des données), habilité à octroyer ou à refuser l'accès à certaines données protégées du secteur public et leur réutilisation. Il a également pour mission de contribuer au développement de la protection des données et de dispenser des conseils en matier/ière de gouvernance des données et de l'intelligence artificielle au sein des administrations étatiques. Il conseille, sur demande, les membres du Gouvernement pour une mise en œuvre cohérente des politiques en ces matier/ières. Enfin dans le cadre de ses missions de conseil et guidance, le CGSD sensibilise les agents publics et développe des documents et des outils adaptés visant à assister les entités en matier/ière de conformité au RGPD. Dans ce cadre, et pour renforcer le Département Autorité luxermbourgeoise des données, le CGSD recherche deux (2) Data Scientists expérimenté(e)s en matier/ière de Privacy et PETs (Privacy-Enhancing Technologies). En ce sens, il faudra pour les personnes qui candidatent être en capacité de satisfaire aux missions ci-après exposées : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions avancées en science des données, avec un focus particulier sur la protection de la vie privée et les technologies d'amélioration de la confidentialité (PETs); Analyser et modéliser des données complexes, développer des algorithmes de machine learning et évaluer leur performance; Identifier et mitiger les risques liés à la confidentialité et à la réidentification dans les projets data et IA, Contribuer à la définition de standards et bonnes pratiques en matier/ière d'anonymisation, pseudonymisation et gestion des données sensibles; Collaborer avec les équipes métier et techniques pour intégrer les contraintes de privacy dans les pipelines de données et les modèles IA; Réaliser des analyses approfondies de qualité des données, de lignée et de conformité privacy; Assurer une veille scientifique et technique sur les avancées en privacy engineering et en techniques d'anonymisation. Profil Compétences techniques Les candidat(e)s devront faire preuve d'un véritable niveau d'expertise, à savoir: Expertise Data: Expertise poussée en modélisation de données, data lineage, data quality et data governance; Maîtrise des environnements Big Data, bases relationnelles et NoSQL, ainsi que des outils de traitement de données massives; Solides compétences en SQL avancé et en raisonnement sur les structures de données complexes; Expérience dans la gestion et la transformation de données sensibles dans des environnements réglementés; Expertise solide sur les standards et modèles de données de (OMOP CDM, OpenEHR, FHIR, HL7). Expertise IA: Maîtrise des techniques de Machine Learning et d'Advanced Analytics (clustering, Random Forest, Boosting, réseaux de neurones, NLP, etc.); Expertise approfondie en Privacy Enhancing Technologies (k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, differential privacy, agrégation, suppression, généralisation, etc.); Expérience dans l'évaluation de modèles, la conception de suites de tests et l'analyse des limites des algorithmes; Connaissance des modèles de langage et des outils d'IA générative appliqués à des cas d'usage privacy et confidentialité. Compétences comportementales Analyser : Vous évaluez les informations, données et contenus de manier/ière critique, le cas échéant dans un environnement digital, vous identifiez les liens logiques et restituez l'information dans une synthèse complète et cohérente; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez...

title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))

description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

You will give input to local and global investment committee and contribute actively to identifying new investment trends, themes and ideas suitable for PWM&FO globally. You will proactively create and present investment ideas based on SEB market outlook and client preferences.

You will support in the client acquisition for discretionary mandates. You will be responsible for the follow- up and communication of the result of implemented investment ideas towards the clients. You will contribute to the continued development of the investment process and investment offering.

You will be based in Luxembourg and be part of the local Asset Management Solutions International Team, as well as part of the global Discretionary Asset Management team. You will be operative towards clients in all PWM&FO geographies. Some travelling may be part of the job.

Bachelor's or master's degree in economics, finance, engineering or related field

Deep understanding of financial markets, financial instruments, investment strategies and portfolio construction characteristics
Strong presentation and communication skills combined with experience from interacting with clients
In-depth understanding of client needs in portfolio management

title: Sr. Manager Ops Concessions, EU Quality (m/f)
description:
Sr. Manager Ops Concessions, EU Quality
Job ID: 10489000 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

*Please note: This position can be based in any of the following corporate offices: LUX20, MAN11 Manchester, MAD12 Madrid, LHR140 London

Are you passionate about improving the customer experience? Do you strive to design and deploy customer-centric solutions that drive measurable results? Does coordinating across teams and countries sound exciting? If so, we are looking for a Sr. Manager to focus on reducing Concessions in EU Operations. You will manage large-scale programs that improve the customer experience and find ways to positively surprise our customers with our services.

We are looking to hire an experienced leader to join the EU Quality leadership team, with background in Amazon Operations. As a Sr. Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing programs that improve both customer experience and efficiency by process improvements. Achieving such aspirational goals will require insisting on the highest standards, developing and iterating on new processes, and driving continuous improvement activities internally and externally. You will build collaborative relationships with numerous teams (operations, tech, and corporate) to identify solutions and to create a project roadmap. You will also prepare and execute regular program updates to senior management on a weekly and monthly basis.

As a Senior Manager in the EU Ops Concessions team, you will lead a team of managers to deliver a critical goal that will directly impact Amazon's P&L. Your objective is to reduce the defect rate and the cost of items that are not delivered to customers and not returned to Amazon. This is a new workstream where you will have the opportunity to innovate and deliver at scale.
These defects often do not reside within a single operations business line but span multiple functions, including first mile (FC), middle mile (ATS), last mile (AMZL, Carrier) and Reverse logistics. You will work closely with senior leaders to influence decision-making and guide them to focus on high-impact areas by creating clear business cases that consider trade-offs.
The success of this role will depend on your ability to successfully deliver programs and improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration. You will need to demonstrate a strong Bias for Action to achieve the team's goals.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the goal of reducing DPMO and costs for the "not delivered – not returned" metrics across EU Amazon.
- Responsible for the operating planning (OP1/OP2) cycles for the program.
- Deliver OP2 savings through initiatives that impact this goal.
- Dive Deep into data to identify the biggest operational opportunities in a new area with a lot of ambiguity.
- Actively seek operational improvement opportunities to ensure items are safely returned to the FC in good condition if they are not delivered.
- Develop and guide team members to focus on the most impactful areas of opportunity.
- Identify trends and take ownership to solve problems. Escalate any delays in timely manner which puts deliverables at risks.
- Support teams (FC, AMZL, GTS, ATS, Relo FC) in prioritizing initiatives to create an end-to-end secure network.
- Lead WBR, MBR, and QBR with end-to-end senior stakeholders (including L8, L10).

A day in the life

You will manage a team of Program Managers and technical team members who will collaborate with various tech, operations, and business stakeholders to drive business-critical programs. You'll challenge and guide the team to ensure timely progress and the completion of their deliverables, coordinate their efforts, and address any lack of traction or adoption where necessary.
You will take ownership of the goal, stay focused on delivering the roadmap, and regularly review milestones. Lead discussion with finance partners to ensure savings glidepaths are met. You'll identify trends early and act without delay. Regularly influence other business lines to maintain focus on the right areas and escalate any delays that put deliverables at risk.

About the team

EU Ops Concessions oversees E2E Ops Controllable Concessions, Undeliverables, and Unreturned items for the EU Amazon Fulfilment network. The team runs EU-wide initiatives aimed at improving the customer experience by identifying, analysing, and resolving operational defects in the First (FCs), Middle (ATS), Last-mile (Carriers and AMZL), and Transportation networks. The products developed by the team are rolled out across the EU Amazon Fulfilment network. As our tools have become the standard in the EU, some have already been adopted by global stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree
- Experience leading and managing a team
- Experience leading complex programs with significant change impact across organizational boundaries
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or a Master's degree and experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate
- Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
- Experience with roadmap strategy and definition

De första tre veckorna av din anställning kommer att tillbringas på vår Academy, där du får utbildning i hur du presenterar Blackjack- och Roulette-spel samt hur du agerar professionellt framför kameran.

title: After-Sales Engineer / Technical Customer Support – Battery Energy Storage Systems (m/f/d) (Kundendienstmonteur/in, -techniker/in)
description:
Über uns

Die RCT Energy Technology GmbH mit Sitz in Konstanz ist ein technologieorientiertes Unternehmen im Bereich Energiespeichersysteme und intelligenter Energielösungen.

Unser Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst Energiespeichersysteme, Wechselrichter, Batterielösungen und Energiemanagementsysteme für private, gewerbliche, industrielle und großtechnische Anwendungen. Dabei stehen technische Innovation, Produktqualität, zuverlässige Projektabwicklung und die Anforderungen unserer Kunden im Mittelpunkt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen After-Sales Engineer (m/w/d) für Batteriespeichersysteme mit Arbeitsort in den Niederlanden.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines hochwertigen technischen Supports und Projektmanagements für unsere CESS-Systeme und gewerblichen Speicherlösungen.
• Planung und Koordination von Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeeinsätzen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern.
• Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service-Level-Agreements (SLA) sowie Wartungsvereinbarungen.
• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort einschließlich der Organisation der erforderlichen Ersatzteilversorgung.
• Technische Unterstützung von Installationspartnern während der Inbetriebnahme von Systemen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort.
• Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines projektbezogenen Berichtssystems zur Nachverfolgung und Optimierung der Supportprozesse.
• Bearbeitung technischer Anfragen über das zentrale Servicepostfach sowie systematische Erfassung und Nachverfolgung der Vorgänge im Ticketsystem.
• Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Rückgabe- und Reklamationsverfahren (RMA) für CESS- und RESS-Systeme.

Ihr Profil

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung im technischen Kundensupport oder im Servicebereich von Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.
• Qualifikationen wie VCA, NEN 3140 VP und NEN 1010 sind von Vorteil.
• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise.
• Teamfähigkeit, Organisationstalent und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit.
• Arbeits- beziehungsweise Wohnort in den Niederlanden sowie die Bereitschaft, unsere Geschäftstätigkeiten innerhalb der Europäischen Union per Remote-Support oder vor Ort zu unterstützen.
• Sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen.
• Gültiger Führerschein und praktische Fahrerfahrung; ein eigenes Fahrzeug ist von Vorteil.

Wir bieten

• Eine anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen der erneuerbaren Energien.
• Die Möglichkeit, innovative großtechnische Batteriespeicherlösungen aktiv mitzugestalten und einen Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft zu leisten.
• Ein teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
• Attraktive Vergütung und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle.
• Umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
• Moderne Arbeitsplätze und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.
• JobRad und JobTicket.

Enjoy a job on the coast of Zeeland. You enjoy making the holiday homes look clean and tidy again. As part of the MVH cleaning team you work in Cadzand, at a beautiful holiday park. The accommodations are gorgeous holiday homes. You are available every Monday and/or Friday. With our bus you can be picked up and drive to Cadzand-Bad to deliver the houses spick and span from 10.00 to 16.00 o'clock.

You go to the location with your team to work in Cadzand with one of our buses or cars. We have pick-up points in Hulst, Axel, Koewacht and Terneuzen. The work includes vacuuming, cleaning wet areas, dusting, removing beds and possibly cleaning a window if it is too dirty.

Do you have an eye for cleanliness, are you meticulous and do you see what others do not see? Register now and join our fun and hard working pool of employees and get to work with your colleagues in Cadzand.

You work on Mondays and/or Fridays from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM in Cadzand. If you are asked to continue working a little longer or an extra day, that is of course no problem for you.

The CAO recreation does not reimburse travel time and travel costs. However, MVH offers you 2 hour extra pay, when you drive a bus or car with collegues!

title: Improved Planning Model for Patient
description:
Note: This application has been filled. Background
Individualizing ovarian stimulation and optimizing workflow in in vitro fertilization (IVF) remains a major clinical and logistical challenge. Treatment outcome and stimulation length are influenced by a wide range of patient-specific factors, including age, ovarian reserve, body mass index (BMI), hormonal profiles, stimulation protocol, medication dose, and previous cycle response. Despite the use of different stimulation protocols based primarily on age and ovarian reserve, the actual duration of stimulation remains unpredictable in approximately 40% of IVF cycles.
This unpredictability has significant consequences for both patients and clinical workflows. Patients often require multiple ultrasound visits to monitor follicular development and adjust medication, increasing treatment burden and stress. At the same time, IVF laboratory workflows are affected by large fluctuations in the number of oocyte pick-ups (OPUs) per day, ranging from one to ten procedures. Such variability complicates staffing, resource allocation, and scheduling, and may ultimately affect treatment efficiency and outcomes.
Currently, no data-driven approach is available to accurately predict stimulation length and the timing of ovum pick-up at the start of treatment. The absence of predictive models limits the ability to provide patient-centered planning and results in inefficient use of clinical and laboratory resources. Recent work has demonstrated that IVF laboratory performance and workflow characteristics are associated with treatment outcomes, highlighting the potential value of predictive planning tools to improve both efficiency and quality of care [1]. Approach
The objective of this project is to develop an AI-driven predictive model that estimates the timing of ovum pick-up for individual IVF patients with an accuracy of one to two days.

Als postbezorger werk je zelfstandig in je eigen buurt én bepaal je elke dag opnieuw zelf wat je werktijden zijn. Tussendoor de (klein)kinderen van school halen, sporten of een tentamen maken? Kan gewoon! Zo ziet je werkdag als postbezorger eruit: Je start met het ophalen van de post bij het depot bij jou in de buurt. De post ligt klaar en hoef je alleen maar in je fietstassen te doen: alles is al keurig per straat en huisnummer gesorteerd. Hoe laat je de post oppikt? Dat bepaal je zelf, zolang het maar vóór 15:00 is. Daarna fiets en loop je je ronde. Lekker in je eigen buurt. En op de tijdstippen die jou het beste uitkomen. Zolang de post veilig staat, kun je gerust tussendoor sporten of avondeten. Als alle post maar uiterlijk om 18:00 uur in de brievenbussen ligt. Extra leuk als postbezorger: Je werkt zelfstandig, maar voelt je nooit alleen. Jij bent al snel een bekende in de wijk en bouwt leuke contacten met bewoners en collega's op. En omdat je lekker actief bezig bent, werk je ongemerkt aan een betere conditie! Wat breng jij mee? Iedereen vanaf 16 jaar kan postbezorger worden. Je bent je ervan bewust dat je hét visitekaartje van PostNL bent. Je werkt dan ook nauwkeurig en stelt je klantgericht op. Daarnaast: Ben je minimaal 7 maanden beschikbaar. Ben je fit genoeg om een paar uur te lopen en te fietsen door je wijk en posttassen van maximaal 23 kilo te tillen. Heb je een stevige fiets met een ijzeren bagagedrager. Spreek je goed Nederlands of Engels. Dit om met je collega's en leidinggevende te communiceren. Heb je een smartphone om te gebruiken tijdens je werk.
