title: Site Manager
description:
Aquatech is a global leader in water purification systems technology for both industrial and infrastructure markets located in the United States and internationally. We support our clients with sustainable water purification systems and technologies that are solving the world's water scarcity challenges.

Aquatech has an immediate need for a full-time Site Manager in Boden, Sweden. The Site Manager will report to the Director of Projects and will perform the duties described in the job description below.

    Oversee, manage, and direct construction from beginning to end.
    Work very closely and coordinate with the Project Manager.
    Create and manage the overall Site Construction Schedule.
    The Site Construction Manager shall be experienced in the same or substantially similar responsibilities on projects similar in size, type, and complexity to the Work and the Facility.
    Extensive industry experience as a construction manager within their area, where we see that the candidate has extensive hands-on project leadership experience in a demanding industrial environment.
    Engaging and effective leadership capability that creates forward momentum and influence across multiple disciplines and functions.
    Highly execution oriented and biased towards decision-making. Knocks down barriers and gets it done.
    Focused on problem solving and first principles orientation - challenge all stakeholders on both requirements and outputs. Proven effective technical competence.
    Ability to work under high pressure and tight deadlines, excellent time management skills.
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as strong coordination.
    Create and issue 3-week lookahead schedules every week
    Manage, plan, organize, implement, and control all construction activities of the project per the Project Schedule
    Track inventory regularly
    Be the primary contact on site for construction & liaison with head office on issues relating to the project progress
    Create contractual documents for the execution of claims-free sub-contracts for site works
    Ensure the project is constructed according to design, budget, and schedule
    Plan to prevent problems and mitigate emerging ones.
    Establish risk profile for project(s) and proactively manage mitigation plans, dealing dynamically with unexpected outcomes to ensure project(s) success
    Ensure that company policies, procedures, standards, etc., are followed
    Site subcontractor management & implementation of HSE (Health, Safety & Environment)
    Ensure site progress as per schedule. If there are delays, initiate the necessary actions like allocating extra resources or alternative work processes to ensure the schedule is back on track
    Report progress to the project manager
    Provide a daily & monthly progress report & update the schedule for submission to the customer
    Discuss with the project team and propose/resolve customer and site-related issues
    Work with the site subcontractor to the standards at the site and maintain alignment with the customer
    Attend customer meetings, contractor meetings, and provide direction
    Ensure timely disposition of the site contractor queries
    Identify and mitigate risks that may have an impact on the project
    Inform the project manager of issues that may affect project profit, costs, schedules, and client relations
    Ensure maintenance of daily records of all site activities, including information on labor and plant, and any non-compliant materials or workmanship
    Monitor project cost and provide the Project Manager with timely identification of deviations from the budget
    Evaluate the change orders/scope change requests of the subcontractor & provide inputs to the project manage
    In case of any accidents, damages, or emergencies at the site, ensure that the proper protocol & procedure

Essential Functions:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above and below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Physical Job Demands:

Lifting/carrying/moving 50 lbs; may need to climb ladders; cannot be afraid of heights; and will need to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while on site. Involves sitting at a desk for extended periods. Needs a high degree of concentration in a busy area.



Qualifications

    A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management is preferred
    Ten (10) or more years of construction-related experience
    Proficient with computer programs, including MS Office suite (Word, Excel, and Outlook), Blue Beam, Navisworks, and navigating 3D models
    Experience in water/wastewater treatment preferred
    OSHA standards and other site safety practices
    Organization and priority-defining skills
    Ability to listen, communicate (written and oral), and willingness to collaborate
    Communicate effectively in English and Swedish.

title: Materials Controller
description:
Aquatech is a global leader in water purification systems technology for both industrial and infrastructure markets located in the United States and internationally. We support our clients with sustainable water purification systems and technologies that are solving the world's water scarcity challenges.

Aquatech has an immediate need for a full-time Material/ Logistics Coordinator in Boden, Sweden. The Material/ Logistics Coordinator will report to the Project Director and will perform the duties described in the job description below.

    Responsible for the daily operation linked to the logistics and delivery flow
    Improve and optimize logistics processes, both locally and globally
    Coordinate with suppliers, customs and shipping providers
    Book special shipments and manage the procurement of stock and logistics abroad
    Coordinates and expedites all shipments to and from the company. This includes both domestic and international (imports and exports).
    Makes sure the company complies with import/export regulations about product classifications and any other documentation requirements such as NAFTA certificates and Shipper's Export Declarations.
    Organize and maintain the proper files as required by regulations.
    Responsible for monitoring rates and charges with third-party freight carriers and negotiating reduced fees, as well as coordinating and scheduling all pick-ups and deliveries using third-party freight carriers and freight forwarders.
    Verifies all incoming shipments for accuracy and is responsible for properly recording received goods information.
    Responsible for major, highly complex domestic and/or international projects, and for ensuring compliance with Aquatech’s established quality standards and business requirements.
    Negotiate agreements to obtain favorable terms and conditions and coordinate the design and implementation of programs to recognize and encourage optimum performance.
    Promote and initiate measures to improve customer satisfaction and the organization's operations by such means as the introduction of the latest strategies and technologies.
    The ideal candidate will be able to purchase all commodities and technical equipment (e.g., pumps, valves, instruments, controls, vessels, and piping) for the manufacturer of water and wastewater treatment systems promptly.
    Generate bid request documents, review quotations when received, prepare bid tabulation spreadsheets, and negotiate orders within budgetary limitations and scope of authority.
    Expedite all orders on assigned projects to obtain and maintain product deliveries and documentation submittals.
    Contacts vendors with discrepancies in quantity and quality.
    File data and compile records and reports for multiple orders on multiple projects simultaneously.
    Interface with all departments to resolve problems and issues.
    Coordinate and oversee the receipt, inspection, storage, and issuance of project materials and equipment.
    Maintain accurate inventory records in the ERP or material tracking system.
    Ensure material availability aligns with project schedules and production needs.
    Track material usage and reconcile discrepancies between physical counts and system data.
    Collaborate with procurement, logistics, and site teams to forecast material requirements.
    Verify supplier documentation, packing lists, and delivery notes for accuracy.
    Support logistics coordination for inbound and outbound material shipments.
    Implement and maintain material control procedures to ensure traceability and compliance.
    Prepare regular reports on material status, shortages, and surplus inventory.
    Enforce safety and housekeeping standards in material storage areas.



Skill Requirements:



    Responsible for the daily operation linked to the logistics and delivery flow
    Improve and optimize logistics processes, both locally and globally
    Coordinate with suppliers, customs and shipping providers
    Book special shipments and manage the procurement of stock and logistics abroad
    Ability to perform computer applications using MS Word, Outlook, Excel, and SAP.
    Duties/tariff/classification knowledge
    Commercial and trade laws
    Vat recovery/Taxation knowledge (overseas)
    Ability to communicate effectively with customers and maintain a positive attitude and good organizational skills.
    Ability to plan and manage multiple tasks or proposals.
    Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
    Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
    Ability to demonstrate initiative and willingness to learn and grow in responsibility on the job.
    Excellent negotiation skills and success in directing vendor selection activities.
    Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to guide direct reports to effectively accomplish performance goals.
    Working knowledge of the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).
    Can speak English and Swedish at a professional level

title: Product Team Engineer - Mechanical
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

We offer a workplace with customers and colleagues from different parts of the world, where cultures and perspectives meet and work together to achieve common goals.



Your mission



Are you interested in and willing to learn and gain a broad technical knowledge about the product family / application and work in an “Product and customer” environment? Where you will interact with - Marketing  - Production, - Aftermarket. Occasionally also with customers/customer centers to gather feedback to gain a better understanding of customer requirements, ensuring these needs are incorporated into future solutions?



Do you see that you would like to grow and, in the future, also take on a new role as product owner in R&D or marketing? Then you might be the one we are looking for!



As “Product Team Engineer” you will collaborate with a cross-functional team, comprised of diverse engineering expertise, and your main tasks will be to lead and implement solutions that will Reduce customers' total cost of ownership (TCO) by solving issues reported by customers and production on existing machine models and implement solutions that improve operator experience and overall machine performance.



Product Team Engineer will also give input regarding product strategy and roadmap and lead troubleshooting investigations in quality and Product Safety cases and continually work to improve product availability and quality through improvement suggestion to the Technical Product Responsible.



Your profile



To be successful in this role you need to have a university degree in Engineering from a relevant area or similar highly qualified documented engineering experience.



As a member of the R&D team, we expect you to be committed to contribute to growing the entire organization towards our vision and strategy, where collaboration, innovation and technology transitions are important examples.



You are customer centric, target focused, and a collaborative team player and we hope that you are curious and dare to think new.



We are searching for several positions with a few years’ experience in Mechanical system design.



You have some knowledge of the products application and are familiar with the tools that you use in your engineering role today, like Teamcenter, 3D cad, AutoCad etc.



You are comfortable in both English and Swedish both speaking and in writing.



Location and travel



This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. Occasional travel is required.

title: Design Manager - Data Centres
description:
Do you want to design the future of sustainable data centres?

Do you have the expertise to lead complex, international engineering projects?

Then you may be the Design Manager we are looking for.

Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At COWI, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.

We are therefore looking for a Design Manager to join us on this journey, becoming an integral part of our growing organisation and helping evolve our data centre environment through your expertise in complex projects.

As Design Manager – Data Centres, you will bring your expertise in engineering and project delivery into multidisciplinary teams, helping translate customer needs into robust and future-ready solutions.

You will be part of a professional environment experiencing rapid growth and strong strategic focus within COWI, with the opportunity to deepen your technical leadership, work on some of the largest data centre projects in the region, and actively influence how COWI delivers international data centre projects.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

    Lead the technical direction and delivery of complex data centre projects, ensuring high quality and consistency across disciplines.
    Engage strategically with customers to understand business drivers and translate them into scalable, resilient and efficient technical solutions.
    Act as technical lead and trusted advisor on major data centre programmes.
    Drive coordination across multidisciplinary teams, ensuring seamless integration of engineering, architecture and sustainability aspects.
    Support project development from early concept and feasibility through design, tender and construction phases.
    Contribute to business development, including client engagement, proposal development and market positioning.
    

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

You are driven by a fast-paced and high-energy environment and thrive when working on complex, large-scale projects where collaboration, technical excellence and clear communication are key to success.

On top of that, you will have:

    A relevant educational background in engineering (e.g. electrical, mechanical, civil or similar).
    Extensive experience working with engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
    Proven experience from data centre projects or other large-scale mission critical facilities.
    Demonstrated experience in leading technical teams and delivering complex engineering projects.
    Strong commercial understanding and ability to engage with senior stakeholders.
    Professional proficiency in English.

Work location

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia.

This includes offices in:

    Norway – Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger, Oslo, Fredrikstad, Haugesund, Bodø, Tromsø, Hamar, Drammen
    Sweden – Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö
    Denmark – Copenhagen, Kongens Lyngby, Vejle, Aarhus, Odense and Aalborg

We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.

Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com and www.arkitema.com where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.



Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

title: Advanced Simulation Software Developer
description:
Do you want to be part of an ambitious and collaborative team, building world-class simulation technology used in real industrial applications?

Then you may be our next...  

Advanced Simulation Software Developer



Digital Products Engineering is responsible for SKF’s portfolio of engineering and simulation software. We work closely with product development, research, application engineering, and customers worldwide to push the boundaries of bearing simulation.

In our Gothenburg-based team, you will contribute to the development of Beast (BEAring Simulation Tool) — SKF’s most advanced simulation platform, used for analysis and prediction of bearing application performance.



Key responsibilities

    Drive the development and verification of new simulation technology
    Work within domains such as multibody dynamics, contact mechanics, tribology, finite element methods, co-simulation, high-performance computing, high-fidelity 3D and surface geometry modelling, and advanced postprocessing
    Collaborate with users and stakeholders to translate needs into technical improvements and effective UI and model building tools
    Engage with product development and application engineering to ensure we deliver measurable impact on product performance, engineering efficiency, and business decisions
    Contribute to the exploration and integration of AI to enhance simulation software capabilities and engineering efficiency
    Contribute to the definition and evolution of simple, efficient, and modern design principles
    Provide advanced technical support in complex customer cases



Requirements

    PhD in mechanical engineering, engineering physics, computer science, mathematics, or similar, or MSc with relevant industry experience
    Experience in developing simulation technology, engineering software, or scientific computing techniques
    Proficiency in programming languages like C++, paired with sound judgment for writing clear, maintainable, and efficient code
    Experience with high-performance computing, contact mechanics and tribology, advanced usage or development of commercial engineering software, or application of AI to support engineering software, are especially meritorious
    Good communication skills and professional fluency in English



You will enjoy working here if you:

    are motivated by developing advanced simulation technology that helps engineers solve complex, real-world engineering problems
    enjoy working at the intersection of physics and software development
    thrive in a collaborative, engaged, knowledge-sharing environment
    value simplicity, clarity, and high engineering standards
    are motivated by seeing your work create real impact across engineering and product development



Our offer

    The chosen candidate will work within an international team developing one of the world’s leading bearing simulation platforms, used across SKF in product development and engineering.
    This role offers a unique combination of advanced physics, high‑performance computing, and real industrial impact, where your work directly influences engineering decisions and product performance.
    We offer competitive employment conditions and support your professional development within SKF.



What you’ll love about SKF…

A culture of diversity and inclusion!

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come asyou are – just be yourself #weareSKF



A Fair and transparent compensation  

We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislations to eligible candidates and base our decisions on objective and gender-neutral criteria, such as professional experience, technical skills, to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process.  

Some additional information

This position will be based in Gothenburg, Sweden.

  

You will report to the Manager Beast Development, who is located in Gothenburg, Sweden.

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Katrin Edelmann, Talent Acquisition Partner Europe & Africa, who is located in Schweinfurt, Germany, by email katrin.edelmann@skf.com. Please note that we can't accept applications via email.

title: QCS Service Engineer
description:
Do you thrive on solving technical challenges and helping customers succeed?

We are strengthening our Scandinavian Service team and are now looking for a QCS Service Engineer to join us in delivering world-class support and expertise for our Valmet IQ solutions.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to deepen their competence within automation, customer support, and the pulp and paper industry while working closely with customers and colleagues across Scandinavia and our global organization.

About the Role

As a QCS Engineer, you will be one of our customers key contacts for Valmet IQ systems. You will take ownership of service cases from start to finish, working closely with customers and supported by our product experts and global operations network.

The role combines field service work, technical problem-solving, customer interaction, and participation in modernization and upgrade projects.

This position is ideally based in Karlstad. However, we are also open to candidates based in Örnsköldsvik or Umeå, as the role involves regular travel to customer sites across Scandinavia.

Your Key Responsibilities

    Provide service and support for Valmet IQ systems
    24/7 on-call service on duty roster
    Build and maintain strong customer relationships
    Plan, execute, and document service visits
    Perform preventive and predictive maintenance activities
    Drive optimization and performance improvement initiatives
    Participate in new deliveries, system extensions, and upgrade projects
    Provide remote technical support when required
    Collaborate closely with colleagues in Scandinavia, Product Line teams in Tampere, Finland, and our global Operations Network

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a technically oriented and customer-focused colleague who enjoys solving problems, taking initiative, and working collaboratively across teams and functions.

    Relevant engineering degree or equivalent experience gained through working with industrial automation/QCS
    Experience with QCS systems; Valmet IQ knowledge is considered an advantage
    Process knowledge and experience from the pulp and paper industry
    Process, tuning and configuration knowledge
    Strong communication and customer service skills
    Ability to work independently and make decisions, even in challenging situations
    Strong organizational and prioritization skills
    Fluent in Swedish and English
    Valid B driver's license
    Willingness to travel within Scandinavia

Join our great team - this is what we can offer

At Valmet, you will have the opportunity to grow and thrive in a dynamic, international environment. In this role, you will expand your expertise in advanced automation and quality control systems while working alongside leading technology specialists and industry experts. You will build a broad network across Valmet and our customer base and become part of an experienced and supportive Scandinavian team. Your work will contribute directly to customer success and operational excellence, while providing excellent opportunities to develop your career within a global technology leader.

Additional information

Please submit your application through the link provided no later than September 6, 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply early.

For additional information, please contact Mattias Mollstedt Manager, Customer Service at mattias.mollstedt@valmet.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.  

When everything works together  

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. With over 19,000 professionals around the world, we are the leading global developer and supplier of technologies, automation and services for the pulp, paper and energy industries, and serve an even wider base of process industries with our automation systems and flow control solutions. Our commitment to moving our customers’ performance forward requires creativity, technological innovations, service know-how – and above all, teamwork.  

Join the team! www.valmet.com/careers

title: Material Investigation Specialist
description:
SKF has been around for more than a century, and today we are one of the world’s largest suppliers of solutions for rotating equipment. Our products are found throughout society — wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions may be in use. This means we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world.



We are now looking to strengthen our Laboratory in Gothenburg with a new team member.



Are you experienced in metallography? Do you enjoy working in a collaborative, problem-solving environment where your work contributes to product quality and performance?

Then you might be our next…



Material Investigation Specialist



We’re looking for a new team member to the Gothenburg Laboratory, which is part of SKF’s Global Laboratory organization.



Our laboratory supports both local SKF factories and global operations with a wide range of materials technology and chemistry services — from heat treatment release analysis to advanced failure investigations.



In this role, you will have the opportunity to build a strong foundation in material investigations. As your experience grows, you will develop expertise in material classification, root cause analysis, and advanced analytical techniques — with the potential to evolve into a more consultative role and contribute broadly across the organization.



You will be part of a skilled and supportive team of nine colleagues based in Gothenburg. While your daily work is locally rooted, you will also engage with Global SKF Laboratories, fostering knowledge exchange and alignment of practices across international teams. The role involves close collaboration with production, engineering, and quality teams, requiring both technical depth and the ability to communicate insights clearly.





Key responsibilities

    Perform heat treatment release analyses to support production and quality assurance
    Conduct metallographic investigations for manufacturing, application engineering, and product/process development
     Provide technical expertise in metallurgy aligned with SKF’s needs
    Contribute to continuous improvement of laboratory processes and service quality
    Participate in knowledge sharing and coordination across SKF’s global laboratory network
    Interpret and document analysis results, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders



Requirements

    A university degree in materials science or a related field
    Experience in metallographic investigation techniques, ideally with some laboratory background — we believe you bring a few years of hands-on experience in this area
    Experience in heat treatment is an advantage
    A curious mindset and a long-term view — you’re motivated to grow in the role and contribute to the team’s development over time
    Ability to zoom in on technical details while also understanding and communicating the broader context and contribution
    Ability to work independently on planned analyses while collaborating with others when needed
    Effective communication skills in Swedish and English — including the ability to explain your technical knowledge to colleagues



SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself. #weareSKF



You’ll enjoy working here if

You’re an effective collaborator with a sense of quality and a forward-thinking approach to your daily work. You are motivated by applying your technical expertise to real-world challenges.

If this sounds like a promising opportunity, we look forward to receiving your application.



We offer

    A well-equipped laboratory with training in metallographic and heat treatment analysis of SKF products
    Opportunities for professional development in metallurgy and analytical techniques
    A workplace that values diversity and inclusion, focusing on your experience, skills, and potential



Some additional information

This position will be based in Gothenburg, Sweden. Local contract.

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Josefin Nelson, Recruitment Expert EMEA, at Josefin.nelson@skf.com.Please note that we can't accept applications via email.



At SKF, we are committed to promoting fairness and inclusivity throughout our recruitment process. To achieve this, we may include assessments and verify the information in your application in compliance with country-specific laws and regulations.

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact the recruiter.



Is this you?

If the answer is yes, submit your application as soon as possible and no later than August 25, 2026.

title: Junior Brand Manager
description:
At Beiersdorf, home of Nivea, Eucerin, Hansaplast & Labello we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.



As Junior Brand Manager, Norway you will be responsible for supporting brand growth and execution for our Eucerin & Hansaplast brands across the Norwegian market, ensuring strong alignment between commercial, media, and marketing activities.

This is a 12 month Fixed Term Contract



Your Tasks

Launch & Trade Marketing

    Coordinate product launches, including bi-annual briefings and trade presentations
    Prepare and deliver product and promotional materials to trade partners
    Gather and consolidate business data to support commercial presentations



Media Planning & Campaign Execution

Influencer & PR Coordination

Performance Tracking & Analysis

Assortment & Business Cases

Budget & Financial Management

    Track spend, evaluate performance, and ensure efficient allocation of resources
    Monitor P&L and analyze sales, market share, and consumer insights



Product Information Management (PIM)

    Ensure accurate and timely product data for all launches
    Maintain and update assortment information consistently



Your Profile

Experience & Background

    1–3 years of relevant experience in marketing, brand management, or a related commercial role
    Experience with campaign execution, agency coordination, or FMCG/pharma is a plus
    Exposure to data analysis and performance tracking is beneficial



Skills & Competencies

    Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks
    Analytical mindset with ability to interpret sales and performance data
    Good communication and presentation skills, both internally and towards external partners
    Detail-oriented with a structured way of working
    Commercial understanding and interest in brand development

  

Languages

    Strong skills in English (spoken and written) – required
    Good understanding of Norwegian (reading, writing, and speaking) – strong advantage

Personal Attributes

    Proactive and self-driven with a willingness to learn and grow
    Collaborative team player with ability to work across functions and markets
    Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
    Strong sense of ownership and accountability



Please submit your CV in English



At Beiersdorf, we see you as a person – far beyond your title or role. Our goal is to provide the flexibility and support you need for your professional and personal success through our work environment. That is why we have a lot to offer!



Competitive salary, bonus (sugject to conditions), Private health insurance, pension, 30 days vacation per year, Wellness fee, Meal vouchers, discounted product purchases, leave entitlements and wellbeing support to include access to an excellent Employee Assistance Programme.



At Beiersdorf, we believe that every individual brings unique perspectives, experiences, and strengths that deserve to be valued and celebrated. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where everyone feels empowered to be themselves, thrive in their role, and work in ways that enable them to succeed. Through flexibility, understanding, accessibility, and meaningful support, we aim to ensure that all colleagues feel respected, heard, and able to reach their full potential.



We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment experience and are happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process to support you.

title: Breakfast and In-Room Dining Associate - Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
description:
Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners, Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.  

We are now seeking a service-oriented Breakfast and In-Room Dining Associate to join our Food & Beverage team and contribute to delivering exceptional dining experiences for our guests. This position also includes responsibilities in room service and lunch service.

For this role, we are looking for someone who is reliable, guest-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced restaurant environment. You take pride in creating a welcoming atmosphere, enjoy working both independently and with a team, and are motivated by providing attentive, high-quality service that exceeds guest expectations.

As a Breakfast Service Associate, you will ensure that our guests begin their day with an outstanding breakfast experience. You will contribute to maintaining our dining areas, delivering personalized service, and upholding the hotel’s standards of quality and hospitality.

Main responsibilities:

    Welcome guests warmly and ensure they feel comfortable and informed about the breakfast buffet offerings.
    Deliver exceptional breakfast and private dining service while taking guest orders and ensuring timely in-room deliveries.
    Maintain the breakfast buffet throughout the service period, ensuring all items are consistently replenished, fresh, and attractively presented.
    Monitor buffet stations for cleanliness, food levels, and presentation, addressing any issues immediately.
    Prepare the restaurant for breakfast service, including setting up the buffet area, arranging tables, and organizing service stations.
    Clear and reset tables efficiently to ensure smooth guest flow.
    Assist guests with special dietary needs, questions about ingredients, and recommendations from the buffet selection.
    Brew and serve coffee, tea, and other beverages as needed.
    Work closely with the kitchen to communicate replenishment needs and ensure timely refills of food items.
    Maintain hygiene, safety, and food-handling standards at all times.
    Support the transition from breakfast to lunch setup when required.


Qualifications:

    Able to fluently communicate verbally in English. Fluency in Swedish is a plus.
    Previous experience in hospitality or a hotel is an advantage but not required.
    Positive attitude and genuine passion for providing excellent guest service.
    Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
    Strong teamwork and communication skills.
    Comfortable with physical work, including lifting and moving items.

In addition:
You are a reliable and service-oriented team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced, event-focused environment.


What We Offer:

    Full time and part time positions following a 6-month probation period, as well as extra positions, all in accordance with the HRF collective agreement.
    Chance of being part of one of the biggest renovation and re-positioning projects in Stockholm’s hotel scene.
    Great opportunities for career growth.
    A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
    Employee discounted rates at over 10 000 hotels worldwide.


Does this position sound interesting and like a good fit for you?

Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

Join our team and play a key role in creating memorable experiences for our guests!

About Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
The Sheraton brand, established in 1937, has been synonymous with excellence in hospitality. The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, opened in 1971 as the first international 5 star hotel in Stockholm, and it’s an icon in Sweden’s capital city. As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location. Our commitment to sustainability aligns with our owner Archer Hotel Managements ethos, making us a unique choice for conscientious travelers.

Redefining the Essence of Hospitality
We are at the end of our renovation journey at Sheraton Stockholm. This marks the beginning of our mission to redefine the essence of hospitality. We have transformed all our spaces, hotel rooms, implemented new food and beverage concepts and expanded our gym and wellness. As we embark on this transformation, we are seeking the best industry people to join our team.

title: Project Manager – Academic Ceremonies to the Stockholm School of Economics
description:
Are you passionate about creating meaningful and memorable academic ceremonies? The Stockholm School of Economics is seeking an exceptionally detail-oriented and service-minded Project Manager to lead and develop SSE’s academic ceremonies and official visits. In this role, you will help shape some of SSE's most important traditions and represent SSE at key moments for students, faculty, alumni, donors, and distinguished guests.

We offer

We offer a central and independent role within the Stakeholder Events team, with significant responsibility and visibility across SSE. You will collaborate closely with students, faculty, the President's Office, Communications, and external partners. Your stakeholders will include distinguished academics, Nobel laureates, leaders from various business communities, the diplomatic corps, donors and benefactors and international visitors and guests.

About the role

In this role, you will:

    Serve as SSE's institutional expert and owner of academic ceremonies, traditions, and protocol, ensuring that the school’s ceremonial practices are maintained, developed, and delivered in a manner that reflects its values, heritage, and international standing.
    Plan and execute SSE's annual academic ceremonies, including Bachelor's, Master's, MBA Graduation ceremonies as well as the Installation & Conferment ceremony.  
    Manage official visits, selected conferences and other stakeholder events.  
    Develop and continuously improve processes, routines, and documentation related to ceremonies and official visits.  
    Collaborate with the Communications team to strengthen awareness of the role and value of academic ceremonies and institutional traditions.  
    Lead project teams, student cohorts, and external suppliers to ensure seamless delivery.
    Serve as SSE’s representative in relevant academic networks.  

The position involves working some evenings and occasional weekends.  

Your profile  

Experience

Required:

    Strong understanding of academic institutions, governance structures, traditions, and stakeholder environments.
    Experience managing complex projects involving senior stakeholders and multiple internal and external partners.

Meritorious:  

    Experience of working in an international context.  
    An academic degree.  
    Project management courses.  
    Service related courses.

Qualifications and personal attributes

    We are looking for someone who combines excellent organizational skills with confidence, professionalism, and a passion for creating exceptional experiences. You have:
    Excellent communication skills with fluency in Swedish and English.  
    A service-oriented, diplomatic approach and the ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels.  
    Maintain and manage sound judgment, discretion, and confidence when working with a variety of leaders, as well as distinguished guests, and formal ceremonial protocols.  
    Strong organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively, manage multiple tasks simultaneously, and maintain exceptional attention to detail.  
    The ability to lead, coordinate, and delegate work to teams, suppliers, and other event partners while taking ownership of projects from planning through execution and evaluation.  
    A proactive, solution-oriented mindset, remaining calm under pressure and comfortable taking initiative.  
    Curiosity and a drive to continuously improve processes and embrace new technologies and systems.  
    Good understanding of budgeting and resource management.  
    A genuine passion for creating meaningful experiences and representing SSE with professionalism and high standards of quality.

Academic ceremonies mark some of the most important milestones in the lives of our students and faculty. They also play a key role in preserving SSE's traditions and strengthening the School's identity and reputation. In this role, you will help shape these moments for generations to come.

About the Stockholm School of Economics

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
About Nordic Air Defence

Nordic Air Defence, headquartered in Stockholm, develops cutting-edge defensive solutions for both civilian and military applications. We combine expertise in electronics, mechanical design, embedded systems, software engineering, and AI.

In September 2024, Nordic Air Defence unveiled its first product, the Kreuger 100, a dual-use drone-interceptor platform engineered in Sweden by a diverse, international team. Our engineers and operators bring experience from leading defence, drone, and tech organisations worldwide, including Palantir, Kratos, SAAB, Anduril, and others.

The Role

This is a full-time, on-site role in Stockholm. As IT Support Engineer, you will own and support the day-to-day IT environment across our offices, production facilities, and flight-test operations.

You will provide hands-on support to employees, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, manage user accounts and devices, and help maintain secure and reliable IT systems.

This is a highly practical role. You will be expected to move quickly, understand real systems, and solve messy problems with users, engineers, and external partners.

Responsibilities:

    Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot laptops, workstations, mobile devices, printers, meeting-room equipment, and other IT hardware.
    Manage employee onboarding and offboarding from an IT perspective, including equipment, accounts, permissions, and documentation.
    Manage user accounts, access rights, licences, email, collaboration tools, and identity-management systems.
    Manage and support telephony, communication, and collaboration systems to ensure reliable day-to-day operations.

Requirements:

    5+ years of experience in IT support, IT operations, systems administration, cloud systems or a similar hands-on IT role.
    Strong practical knowledge of Windows, MacOS, Linux, and common workplace IT environments.
    Experience administering Microsoft 365 or similar cloud-based productivity and identity platforms.
    Experience with cybersecurity and information security, including security best practices, access control, endpoint security, and incident handling.
    Fluent in Swedish and English

Desirable:

    Experience in defence, aerospace, robotics, autonomy, or similar
    Experience in a fast paced startup or scaleup company
    Experience with cloud based infrastructure, DevOps, Gitlab, and CI

Benefits:

    Generous PTO and holidays
    Competitive salary with opportunities for performance-based bonuses
    Stock options with upside in the company’s success

Additionally:

    You are ideally a citizen of a NATO country
    You must be prepared to relocate to Stockholm permanently
    Any experience working with the defence industry

title: Creative Coordinator
description:
About Nordic Air Defence

Nordic Air Defence, headquartered in Stockholm, develops cutting-edge defensive solutions for both civilian and military applications. We combine expertise in electronics, mechanical design, embedded systems, software engineering, and AI.

In September 2024, Nordic Air Defence unveiled its first product, the Kreuger 100, a dual-use drone-interceptor platform engineered in Sweden by a diverse, international team. Our engineers and operators bring experience from leading defence, drone, and tech organisations worldwide, including Palantir, Kratos, SAAB, Anduril, and others.

The role

This is a full-time, on-site role in Stockholm. We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Creative Coordinator to work closely with our Creative Director in an operational capacity and help build the Creative Department.

This is an operational role within the Creative Department, not a creative development role. You will act as the operational backbone of the team, helping coordinate projects and logistics, conduct research, manage follow-ups, and ensure the department stays organized and ahead of upcoming needs.

You will be given clear objectives and trusted to figure out how to make things happen. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, and maintaining a clear operational overview and structure in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

    Coordinate day-to-day operations within the Creative team and maintain a clear overview of what is happening across the organization, including who owns what, what is being worked on, what is coming up, and where Creative needs to be involved.
    Track projects, priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and follow-ups, ensuring that nothing falls between the cracks.

    Coordinate meetings, action items, and follow-ups across internal and external stakeholders.

    Support production planning and execution, including crew outreach, travel, accommodation, permits, schedules, call sheets, suppliers, equipment logistics, and hands-on production support on set when required.
    Help protect and enforce Creative processes internally, ensuring materials that require Creative review or approval follow the agreed workflow.

Requirements

    1–3 years of experience in operations, coordination, administration, project support, or a similar role.
    Professional fluency in English.
    Driver's license required.
    Comfortable managing budgets, spreadsheets, and cost tracking.
    Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a strong ability to follow through and close open tasks.
    Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership and working independently.
    Strong research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn information into clear conclusions and recommendations.
    Confident communicating with different stakeholders and comfortable proactively reaching out to people.
    Reliable and willing to help with both high-level coordination and practical tasks.
    Willingness to travel and support productions on location when required, including helping with equipment, transport and other practical tasks.

﻿Nice to have

    Experience from a startup, operations, logistics, project coordination, hospitality, events, or another fast-paced environment.
    Experience supporting multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.

Form of employment: full time with initial 6 month probation period

Start date: ASAP

Location: Solna Strand

Reporting to: Creative Director & Head of Brand

title: Buyer needed!
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of global logistics? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where collaboration, strategic thinking and strong supplier relationships drive real business value? Join a global procurement team and help develop smarter, more sustainable transport solutions.

About the position

We are looking for a Buyer for our client, a well-known company withing the automotive industry. You will be working from the office based in Gothenburg.

As part of the Logistics Procurement team, you will play a key role in developing supplier strategies and securing efficient transport solutions across Ocean, Road, Rail, Air and multimodal services. You will work in a global environment, collaborating closely with suppliers and stakeholders across logistics, engineering and manufacturing to create value through cost, quality and sustainability.

    Develop and implement category and supplier strategies

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity?

    Strong project management skills with the ability to successfully drive complex sourcing projects in challenging and uncertain environments

Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-09-20. Start 2026-09-21.

description:

Är noggrann, punktlig och ansvarstagande

title: Security Guard (Väktare)
employer: STIFTELSEN BORGEN 2 - BRITISH INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL STOCKHOLM
description:
SECURITY GUARD (Väktare)

British International School of Stockholm, Altorp & Ekeby Campus

Location: Stockholm, Sweden (Altorp Campus & Ekeby Campus)

Contract type: Full Time (term time/uppehållstjänst)

Contract term: Fixed-Term Contract (1 years)

Hours of work: 8:00 - 16:30

Salary: Based on qualifications and experience

Job starts: Immediate start available

About the job

The British International School of Stockholm is seeking a dedicated and proactive Security Guard to ensure the safety and security of our vibrant international school community. This role is ideal for someone who values a secure and welcoming environment for students, staff, and visitors alike.

As a key member of our school community, the Security Guard will be highly visible across both campuses, monitoring school grounds, managing access control, and ensuring a smooth and safe flow of movement throughout the school day. The role also includes responding to security concerns, assisting in emergency preparedness drills, and providing support for school events.

In addition to security duties, the ideal candidate will have a hands-on approach to basic maintenance tasks, demonstrating problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude in handling minor repairs and upkeep and possess basic IT literacy to assist the IT department with localized troubleshooting.

Swedish language skills and physical capability to manage practical tasks are highly valued for this role.

If you are a reliable, solutions-oriented professional with a keen sense of responsibility and a commitment to maintaining a safe and positive school culture, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities and expectations

    Maintain a highly visible presence across both school campuses, ensuring a safe and secure environment for students, staff, and visitors.
    Monitor school entrances and grounds, ensuring only authorised personnel and visitors access the premises.
    Greet, screen, and direct visitors, following security and safeguarding procedures.
    Patrol school buildings, grounds, and parking areas to deter, detect, and report any security concerns, unauthorised activities, or safety hazards.
    Respond promptly to security incidents, notifying the appropriate authorities (e.g. management, police, or fire department) when necessary.
    Ensure smooth and safe traffic flow during arrival and dismissal times.
    Assist in emergency preparedness drills, including fire drills and lockdown drills.
    Support after-school events and activities by providing security as needed.
    Demonstrate problem-solving skills, proactively identifying and addressing security or maintenance issues.
    Perform minor maintenance tasks as required, including basic repairs and handling equipment/tools.
    Act as on-site 'smart hands' for the IT team by providing basic technical support.
     Collaborate with school staff and administration to maintain a safe and supportive school culture.
    Attend and successfully complete all staff development training required by school policies.
    Perform other duties within the scope of the role as assigned by the School Director or Head of Security.

Minimum qualifications

    Fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively in both spoken and written formats.
    Eligible to work in Sweden.
    Basic security training or relevant experience in a similar role (e.g., security guard, public safety).
    Ability to perform basic maintenance tasks and demonstrate physical capability to carry out tasks such as lifting, repairing, and managing equipment.
    Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact respectfully and positively with students, staff, and visitors.
    Demonstrates self-control, confidence, and composure under pressure, with the assertiveness to lead when needed, empathy and fairness towards others, and a strong commitment to confidentiality.
    Ability to handle emergency situations calmly and in accordance with school policies and procedures.
    Attention to detail and the ability to identify security or safety risks proactively.
     Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a practical approach to resolving issues.
    Proven reliability and punctuality, with a strong sense of responsibility and trustworthiness.
    A commitment to maintaining a safe, inclusive, and positive school environment.

Preferred qualifications

    Fluency in Swedish.
    Previous experience in a security-related role, particularly within a school or educational setting.
    Basic first aid certification or willingness to obtain one.
    Experience working with diverse groups and understanding cultural sensitivities.
    Familiarity with emergency response protocols and safety systems in educational institutions.
    Technical skills for handling security systems (e.g., CCTV, alarm systems) or willingness to learn.
    Experience in basic maintenance tasks or familiarity with tools and equipment used for minor repairs.

To apply

Please send the following documents, in English, to recruitment@bisstockholm.se, putting “Security Guard” as the email subject:

    A completed BISS application form - this is found on our website
    A letter of application and CV
    Successful candidates will be invited for an interview.

Closing date

The deadline for applications will be August 28th 2026. However, BISS reserves the right to interview and appoint outstanding candidates before this date.

If you would like to learn more about this position, you are welcome to contact our Head of Security, Bogdan Baciu-David, at b.baciu-david@bisstockholm.se. He will be happy to answer any questions or provide additional information about the role.

For further information about the British International School of Stockholm, please visit our website.

title: Data Engineer
description:
If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?

We are now looking for a Data Engineer!

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, optimization, and operation of our data infrastructure and backend systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of engineers, focusing on technologies such as SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, Azure, C# and ASP.NET Core. If you are passionate about building scalable, efficient, data-driven backend solutions, we want to hear from you.

Who you are:

    

You have experience tuning all aspects of SQL Server, including query and execution-plan analysis and know exactly where to place the right index.

    

Your savvy troubleshooting skills include identifying and mitigating locking and concurrency issues.

    

You know what is important when it comes to observability and monitoring, what needs acting on as well as identifying blind spots.

    

You are comfortable automating and orchestrating repetitive tasks such as reports and data exports.

    

You are experienced with data classification and different retention needs.

    

You have experience in backend development using C# and ASP.NET Core.

    

You are familiar with cloud platform providers such as Azure and their data infrastructure services.

What you'll do:

    

Database management: Design and implement efficient database structures using SQL Server, optimizing data storage, and retrieval for optimal system performance.

    

Database operations: Ensure database operations under sustained production load are healthy and performant, supporting both players, designers and fellow developers in their day-to-day activities.

    

Database observability: Create and maintain alert rules, the SQL metrics exporter, Grafana dashboards, and Extended-Events-based performance diagnostics.

    

Data pipelines: Operate and evolve the Azure Data Factory pipelines, maintenance, and telemetry events.

    

Application development: Design and develop backend solutions using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft Orleans, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.

    

Cloud integration: Utilize Azure services to build and optimize cloud-based backend components, ensuring seamless integration with our applications.

    

Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the successful delivery of projects.

Our tech stack

    

Azure SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, NET/C#, ASPNET Core, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, CosmosDB, Redis, Grafana, MS Orleans, Kafka

How to apply

If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.

We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.  

Practical Information

Scope: Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period. Location: Office first.

We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find cute dogs and occasionally some cats around.

What we offer

Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 140+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.

Located in the heart of Södermalm, in Fatburen in the middle of the Game Dev scene we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. The is a a lot of different types of activities immediately available on our doorstep.

Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.

We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!

title: Vice President Compensation & Benefits  Sandvik Group
description:
People are one of Sandvik’s most important success factors. Competitive, transparent, and business-relevant reward programs are therefore essential to attracting, engaging and retaining the people who drive our continued success.

We’re now looking for an experienced and commercially minded Vice President Compensation & Benefits to lead and further develop our global Compensation & Benefits function. This is a highly influential role at the center of a global, decentralized and continuously evolving organization, with the opportunity to shape how Compensation & Benefits supports business performance, profitable growth and long-term value creation.

Your mission

You set the strategic direction and lead the development of Compensation & Benefits across Sandvik Group. You ensure that our global reward framework supports the Group’s business strategy and balance clear governance with the needs of our decentralized businesses and local markets.

You act as a trusted advisor to the EVP and Chief HR Officer, senior management, and the Remuneration Committee. You lead the Group Compensation & Benefits team at Group level, including Executive compensation, Pensions and benefits, Global mobility and Global Rewards Operations, data and projects. You also chair Sandvik’s global Compensation & Benefits forum and work closely with the Compensation & Benefits leaders across our four Business Areas and the regional organizations. You’re an engaged peer in Sandvik’s Group HR Management team.  

Job responsibilities also include;

    Translating business needs into decentralized Compensation & Benefits practices that enable Business Areas and Divisions to succeed.
    Designing and implementing Compensation & Benefits procedures and policies with primary focus to support a high-performing organization and contribute to a strong performance culture.
    Developing Sandvik’s approach to areas such as pay transparency, equal pay, executive remuneration, pensions and benefits governance, regulatory requirements and data-driven decision-making.
    Strengthening the function’s contribution to Sandvik’s growth agenda, by ensuring that Compensation & Benefits expertise is brought into acquisitions, including due diligence and post-merger integration.

Location  

The position is based in Stockholm, Sweden and requires travel.

Your profile

You have a successful track record from translating business needs into Compensation & Benefits structures, creating growth and value across a variety of organizations. You have extensive experience within global Compensation & Benefits or Total Rewards, gained in international and complex organizations.

You understand how reward structures influence performance, behavior, cost and value creation, and you are genuinely interested in understanding and supporting Sandvik’s businesses and operations. You enjoy speaking business from an HR and reward perspective.

Your background also includes:

    A strong and broad experience in executive compensation, incentive design, remuneration governance and interaction with senior management.
    Experience leading global teams and operating through both direct and indirect reporting lines in a decentralized business model.
    Relevant experience from business growth, transformation and M&A, including reward-related due diligence and integration.
    Strong financial and business acumen, with a genuine interest in investor and shareholder perspectives.

It’s highly meriting with experience from:

    International industrial, engineering and/or technology companies.
    Direct interaction with Remuneration Committees in a listed environment.
    Broader HR Director, financial and/or other leadership positions.

You’re curious, culturally versatile, and comfortable navigating across a truly global footprint. You naturally build trust across cultures and organizational levels, and between the business and your expert function. You naturally and constructively interact with, and challenge, senior stakeholders. Collaborative and low in prestige, you’re successful by being present and close to the business. You combine integrity with a pragmatic approach and know how to navigate between firm governance and business needs.

title: Scrum Master OneService
description:
About the job

We are now looking for a structured and people-focused Scrum Master to support our teams in growing, maintaining alignment, and successfully delivering value.



You'll join a global team of approximately 20 people working across two Agile teams. One team focuses on Field Service, supporting technicians who work directly with customers, while the other supports Service Centres, where equipment is serviced and repaired. The two teams share the same Product Owner, Scrum Master, QA Lead, and Solution Architect. As the Scrum Master, you will support both teams in their ways of working, delivery, collaboration, and continuous improvement.



The Product Owner defines business priorities, while you help the teams translate these priorities into actionable plans and sustainable ways of working. You will guide the teams through planning, follow-up, and continuous improvement, while helping people stay focused on shared goals and agreed ways of working.



Your responsibilities will include:

    

Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and follow-up activities

    

Support trust, commitment, and collaboration within and between the two teams and with other teams we collaborate with

    

Establish clear structures for planning, prioritization, follow-up, and continuous improvement

    

Keep the teams focused on shared goals, timelines, and agreed ways of working

    

Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and support the teams in resolving them proactively

    

Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to align priorities and proactively communicate risks to delivery

    

Coach the teams in Agile principles, Scrum, and self-organization

    

Foster open communication and an inclusive team culture

    

Encourage experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning

    

Drive long-term improvements in ways of working and team effectiveness



The role requires 2-3 days onsite per week in Lund.



Who are you

You are structured, collaborative, and confident in leading teams through change and complexity. You build trust, create clarity, and help others grow. You are empathetic and approachable, while also being comfortable challenging teams when needed to improve focus, accountability, and delivery.



You believe in self-leadership and know how to guide teams towards greater ownership without losing momentum. You know when to coach and empower the team, and when to step in to provide direction or remove obstacles.



You see challenges as opportunities to learn and grow, and you encourage your teams to do the same. You enjoy working closely with people, building strong team dynamics, and turning plans into action. Proactive and solution-oriented, you are motivated by helping teams succeed together.



What you know

    

Deep understanding of Agile frameworks and Scrum principles. Experience working with SAFe is an advantage

    

Several years of experience working as a Scrum Master or in a similar Agile leadership role

    

Background in IT delivery; knowledge of software development is a plus

    

Experience working with SaaS platforms is a plus

    

Experience leading global teams and people from diverse cultural backgrounds

    

Experience with change management and team transformation is an advantage

    

Strong skills in capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery management

    

Ability to navigate complexity and create structure in changing environments

    

Proven ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across functions and stakeholders in a complex, global organization

    

Strong communication and facilitation skills in English

    

Experience supporting multiple Agile teams is an advantage



What's in It for You?

Join a people-focused organization built on collaboration, trust, and open communication, and become part of a large and complex IT landscape. You'll be part of a global setup where different perspectives and shared success are valued. As Scrum Master for a key solution supporting Alfa Laval's global service execution, you'll have the opportunity to work across teams and make a tangible impact on how we deliver service worldwide.

This is an opportunity to take on a meaningful role in a complex organization, where your ability to create clarity, strengthen collaboration, and enable teams to succeed can have a real impact.



We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.

We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Please send your application no later than August 23rd , 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!

At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund or have an established presence in the area.

Our commitment to integrity
We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.

As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.

title: Software Developer
description:
​

    Design, develop, test, and maintain frontend, backend services and/or integrations
    Work end-to-end: requirement analysis, design, implementation, deployment, monitoring and maintenance
    Improve existing systems with focus on performance, stability, and maintainability
    Monitor production systems and handle incidents when needed

    Take ownership of tasks from idea to production, including documentation, quality assurance and knowledge sharing
    Support and guide team members and contribute to team development

Good fit if you have:

    3–5 years of hands-on software development experience
    Strong experience in Microservices, Java and Spring Boot
    Strong SQL knowledge
    Experience working in agile scrum teams

Nice to have / technologies the team works with:

    Message bus (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
    Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD
    NoSQL (Cassandra)

    Monitoring and observability tools

Bottom line

If you enjoy working with complex systems, understanding the real customer impact of your work, and working in a team where reliability truly matters, this role is a strong match.

Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.

For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company’s track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.

Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.

Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed in the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.
